These writers assumed that labor was more divided along gender lines than was in fact the case.
原文并没有说作家认为男女分工“更严格”。问题出在他们 过度强调了女性织布，而不是讨论男女分工程度。

These writers failed to distinguish the variety of tasks included in men's labor.
文中完全没有提到“男性劳动的多样性”。批评点只在于他们对“女性劳动”的描写单一化。

These writers overestimated the role of household labor in the Chinese economy.
原文没有说他们对家庭劳动在整体经济中的作用“高估”或“低估”。讨论点是女性劳动的具体内容，而不是家庭劳动的宏观地位。

These writers underestimated the contribution of men's labor to the Chinese economy.
文中没有提到“低估男性劳动”。批评点是他们对女性劳动的错误呈现。

html: Despite today's more eﬃcient electrical generators, modern electric-only power plants waste more of their fuel sources potential energy than did Thomas Edison's power plants of the late 1800s. Edison used cast-oﬀ steam from his generators to warm nearby homes and factories. But few modern power plants use this residual heat, instead venting it into the air. When newer, larger plants required more real estate, they were built farther from customers. Moreover, because electricity travels easily, plants were located wherever they could tap the energy of a river or where local coal was especially cheap. The heat generated during the production of electricity does not travel far, however, so when power plants moved out to the horizon, the steam went to waste.
zh:
①尽管今天的发电机效率更高，但与19世纪末托马斯·爱迪生的发电厂相比，现代纯电力发电厂浪费了更多的燃料来源势能。
②爱迪生用发电机排出的蒸汽为附近的家庭和工厂供暖。
③但很少有现代发电厂使用这种余热，而是将其排放到空气中。
④当更新、更大的工厂需要更多的土地时，它们被建在离用户更远的地方。
⑤此外，由于电力运输方便，工厂被建在任何可以利用河流能源的地方，或者当地煤炭特别便宜的地方。
⑥然而，发电过程中产生的热量传输范围有限，所以当发电厂搬到地平线上时，蒸汽就浪费了。

qs.stem: It can be inferred from the passage that, in general, locating modern power plants closer to population centers would have
qs.zh: 从这段话中可以推断出，一般来说，将现代发电厂建在离人口中心更近的地方会

opts.t: compromised eﬀorts to conserve energy in populated areas
opts.cn: 损害人口密集地区的节能努力

opts.t: decreased the demand for heating within those population centers
opts.cn: 降低人口中心的供热需求

opts.t: resulted in higher costs for the fuel used by those plants
opts.cn: 导致电厂燃料成本上升

opts.t: required much larger plants than those currently operating
opts.cn: 需要比目前运行的发电厂大得多的发电厂

opts.t: obliged power companies to find an alternative to coal as a fuel source
opts.cn: 迫使电力公司寻找煤炭以外的燃料来源

qs.label: C
qs.why:
根据第四句和第五句，现代电厂通常建在能够利用河流能量或当地煤炭便宜的地方。这暗示了，电厂的地理位置选择是基于能源成本的考量。如果电厂靠近人口中心，它们可能无法享受这些成本优势，因此可能导致燃料成本增高，对应C选项。

其他选项：
compromised efforts to conserve energy in populated areas
文章没有提到将现代电厂置于人口中心会妨碍节能努力。实际上，如果电厂靠近人口中心，可能会更有效地利用剩余热量（如供暖），这在理论上是一种节能方式，而不是妨碍节能。
decreased the demand for heating within those population centers
文章没有提到电厂靠近人口中心会使得供暖需求下降。
required much larger plants than those currently operating
文章没有提到靠近人口中心需要更大规模的电厂。
obliged power companies to find an alternative to coal as a fuel source
文章中并未提及电厂靠近人口中心会迫使公司寻找替代煤炭的燃料。位置选择主要是基于能源成本和可用性，而不是燃料类型的必要替换。

qs.stem: The author suggests that steam generated by modern power plants is not used for heating because
qs.zh: 作者认为，现代发电厂产生的蒸汽不用于供暖，因为

opts.t: steam generally proves incompatible with most modem industrial needs
opts.cn: 蒸汽通常不符合大多数现代工业需求

opts.t: other means of heating have become more cost-eﬀective
opts.cn: 其他取暖方式的成本效益更高

opts.t: steam is no longer produced in suﬃcient quantities to be useful
opts.cn: 蒸汽的生产量已不足以满足需要

opts.t: insuﬃcient demand for heating exists nearby
opts.cn: 附近的供热需求不足

opts.t: transporting steam long distances would prove to be prohibitively expensive
opts.cn: 长途运输蒸汽的成本过高

qs.label: D
qs.why:
“Edison used cast-off steam from his generators to warm nearby homes and factories. But few modern power plants use this residual heat, instead venting it into the air.”
爱迪生把余热用于给附近住宅和工厂供暖；现代电厂很少这样做，而是把余热排入空气。
“they were built farther from customers.” … “The heat generated during the production of electricity does not travel far, however, so when power plants moved out to the horizon, the steam went to waste.”
后来新厂因需地增多而建得更远；而发电时产生的热量不能远距离传输，因此当电厂搬远后，蒸汽就被浪费掉了。

说明作者认为现代电厂不把蒸汽用来供暖，是因为附近没有足够的供暖需求（plants moved away，使得附近没有需求），对应选项 D。

其他选项：
steam generally proves incompatible with most modern industrial needs
原文没有说蒸汽与现代工业不兼容。相反，文中强调的是“few modern power plants use this residual heat… venting it into the air”，理由在于地点与热量传输问题，而非蒸汽不适用。

other means of heating have become more cost-effective
原文没有提到替代供暖方式或成本比较。作者解释的原因是电厂选址与热量不能远传（“The heat generated… does not travel far”），没说有更便宜的加热手段。

steam is no longer produced in sufficient quantities to be useful
原文并没说蒸汽产量不足。事实上文中仍提到“the steam went to waste”，这暗示蒸汽存在但没有被利用。

transporting steam long distances would prove to be prohibitively expensive
原文说的是热量“does not travel far”，强调物理上/热量传输上的限制，并没讨论运输蒸汽的费用或“prohibitively expensive”。

html: The highly dispersed nature of Panzaleo pottery throughout present-day Ecuador has led archaeologists to speculate about the pottery's origins and significance. Jijón y Caamaño attributed the pottery's distribution to trade, and based on the large quantities of pottery recovered in the Ambato-Latacunga region of the central Ecuadorian highlands, he proposed that region as the probable locus of production. However, Porras suggests that inhabitants of the subtropical eastern Andean slopes, or montaña, were the original producers of Panzaleo. Porras' theory involves the forced migration of the montaña population from their homeland in the Quijos River valley into the Ecuadorian highlands. The gradual exodus and ensuing dispersal of the makers of this ware could account for the diffuse distribution of the materials.
zh:
①P陶器在当今厄瓜多尔的高度分散性使考古学家推测这种陶器的起源和意义。
②JC 将陶器的分布归因于贸易，基于在厄瓜多尔中部高地的 AL 地区发现的大量陶器，他提出该地区可能是生产地。
③然而，P认为，安第斯山脉东部亚热带斜坡或山地的居民是P陶器的原始生产者。
④P的理论涉及 m人从其位于奎霍斯河谷的家园被迫迁移到厄瓜多尔高地。
⑤这种器皿的制造者逐渐外流和随后的分散可能是材料分散分布的原因。

qs.stem: It can be inferred from the passage that Jijón y Caamaño would probably agree with which of the following statements about the distribution of Panzaleo pottery throughout Ecuador?
qs.zh: 从文中可以推断出，JC 很可能会同意以下关于P陶器在厄瓜多尔全境分布的哪种说法？

opts.t: This distribution is not primarily the result of the relocation of the original makers of the pottery.
opts.cn: 这种分布主要不是陶器原始制作者迁移的结果。

opts.t: This distribution originally took place over a relatively short period of time.
opts.cn: 这种分布最初发生的时间相对较短。

opts.t: This distribution could not have occurred without the forced migration of certain peoples.
opts.cn: 如果没有某些民族的被迫迁徙，这种分布是不可能发生的。

opts.t: This distribution was largely limited to the Ambato-Latacunga region.
opts.cn: 这种分布主要局限于 AL 地区。

opts.t: This distribution indicates that the Ambato-Latacu region was known primarily as a trading center.
opts.cn: 这一分布情况表明，AL 地区主要以贸易中心而闻名。

qs.label: A
qs.why:
文中先说：“Jijón y Caamaño attributed the pottery's distribution to trade”
Jijón y Caamaño 认为这种陶器之所以分布很广，主要原因是 贸易。
接着说：“based on the large quantities of pottery recovered in the Ambato-Latacunga region … he proposed that region as the probable locus of production.”
他还认为 Ambato-Latacunga 地区很可能是生产中心。也就是说，在他看来，陶器是从一个生产中心通过贸易扩散出去的。

而后面介绍的 Porras 理论是另一种解释：“forced migration … The gradual exodus and ensuing dispersal of the makers of this ware could account for the diffuse distribution …”
因为原始制作者被迫迁移、逐渐散开，所以陶器才分布得这么广。

可以推出，Jijón y Caamaño 既然把分布归因于 trade，那他大概率不会认为这种分布主要是因为“原始制作者迁移到了各地”。对应 A 选项。

其他选项：
This distribution originally took place over a relatively short period of time.
原文只说 Jijón y Caamaño 把分布归因于 “trade”，并没有提到这个分布过程花了多长时间。

This distribution could not have occurred without the forced migration of certain peoples.
“forced migration” 是 Porras' theory 里的内容，不是 Jijón y Caamaño 的看法。

This distribution was largely limited to the Ambato-Latacunga region.
文章开头就说这种陶器在 Ecuador 是 “highly dispersed”，说明分布很广。
Ambato-Latacunga 在 Jijón y Caamaño 看来是 “the probable locus of production”，也就是可能的生产地，不等于说分布主要只局限在这里。

This distribution indicates that the Ambato-Latacu region was known primarily as a trading center.
原文说他根据该地区出土陶器数量大，认为这里是 “the probable locus of production”。
说明它可能是 生产中心，不是说它“primarily”是贸易中心。这里把“生产地”偷换成了“交易中心”。

qs.stem: The passage cites evidence supporting which of the following hypotheses?
qs.zh: 这段话引用了证据支持了以下哪种假设？

opts.t: Jijón y Caamaño's hypothesis about the relationship between trade and the distribution of Panzaleo pottery
opts.h: Jijón y Caamaño's hypothesis about the relationship between trade and the distribution of Panzaleo pottery
opts.cn: JC 关于贸易与 P陶器分布之间关系的假设

opts.t: Jijón y Caamaño's hypothesis about the probable locus of Panzaleo pottery production
opts.h: Jijón y Caamaño's hypothesis about the probable locus of Panzaleo pottery production
opts.cn: JC 关于 P陶器生产的可能地点的假设

opts.t: Porras' hypothesis about who the original producers of Panzaleo pottery were
opts.h: Porras' hypothesis about who the original producers of Panzaleo pottery were
opts.cn: P 关于谁是P陶器最初生产者的假设

opts.t: Porras' hypothesis about the forced migration of certain peoples
opts.h: Porras' hypothesis about the forced migration of certain peoples
opts.cn: P 关于某些民族被迫迁徙的假设

opts.t: Porras' hypothesis about the dispersal of the original makers of Panzaleo pottery
opts.h: Porras' hypothesis about the dispersal of the original makers of Panzaleo pottery
opts.cn: P 关于 P陶器原始制作者分散的假设

qs.label: B
qs.why:
原文第二句 "based on the large quantities of pottery recovered in the Ambato-Latacunga region of the central Ecuadorian highlands, he proposed that region as the probable locus of production." JC提出AL地区可能是P陶器的生产地，证据是在厄瓜多尔中部高地AL地区发现的大量陶器。

其他选项：
"Jijón y Caamaño's hypothesis about the relationship between trade and the distribution of Panzaleo pottery"
原文提到 JC 将陶器的分布归因于贸易，但没有详细的证据支持这个假设。
"Porras' hypothesis about who the original producers of Panzaleo pottery were"
P 认为是亚马逊东坡的居民是最初的生产者，但原文没有提供确凿的证据支持这个假设。
"Porras' hypothesis about the forced migration of certain peoples"
P 提到强制迁徙，但原文没有直接提供支持这个假设的证据。
"Porras' hypothesis about the dispersal of the original makers of Panzaleo pottery"
P 提到制作者的扩散，但没有具体的证据支持这个假设。

html: The fact that certain musical qualities were shared by African American and White jazz musicians in the mid- 1950s was sometimes explained by claiming that jazz was “color-blind.” Yet a look at how the discourse of color blindness was deployed in 1950s jazz periodicals helps explain why many African American jazz musicians began to emphasize differences, rather than similarities, between the aesthetic styles of Black and White musicians. The discourse of “color blindness” tended to exaggerate the permeability of racial boundaries by failing to address the power relationships involved in a social climate where evasiveness about race was often used to silence African American perspectives on the meaning of jazz. While the expression of color-blind sentiments was not necessarily disingenuous, structural racial stratification remained powerful beyond the bandstand.
zh:
①事实上，在20世纪50年代中期，非裔美国人和白人爵士音乐家有着共同的音乐品质，这一事实有时可以通过声称爵士乐是“色盲”来解释。
②然而，看看50年代爵士乐期刊中色盲的论述是如何展开的，有助于解释为什么许多非裔美国人爵士音乐家开始强调介于黑人和白人音乐家的审美风格之间的差异而不是相似之处。
③“色盲”的话语往往夸大了种族界限的渗透性，因为它没有解决社会环境中涉及的权力关系，在这种社会环境中，对种族的回避往往被用来压制非裔美国人对爵士乐意义的看法。
④虽然色盲情绪的表达并不一定是虚伪的，但结构性的种族分层在音乐台之外仍然很强大。

qs.stem: The author mentions “power relationships” primarily to
qs.zh: 作者提到“权力关系”主要是为了

opts.t: help summarize an argument that the author wishes to refute
opts.cn: 帮助总结作者想要反驳的论点

opts.t: account for the inadequacy of a particular idea about jazz
opts.cn: 解释关于爵士乐的一个特定观点的不足

opts.t: demonstrate a link between social and aesthetic factors affecting Jazz musicians
opts.cn: 展示影响爵士音乐家的社会因素和审美因素之间的联系

opts.t: emphasize the commitment of some jazz musicians to a particular view of jazz
opts.cn: 强调一些爵士乐音乐家对爵士乐的特定观点的承诺

opts.t: cite evidence to support a claim about stylistic developments within jazz in the 1950s
opts.cn: 引用证据支持20世纪50年代爵士乐风格发展的说法

qs.label: B
qs.why:
定位到加粗部分所在句： The discourse of “color blindness” tended to exaggerate the permeability of racial boundaries by failing to address the power relationships involved in a social climate where evasiveness about race was often used to silence African American perspectives on the meaning of jazz.
在这篇文章中，作者讨论了1950年代，爵士乐界“色盲”话语的使用方式及其对非裔美国爵士乐手和白人爵士乐手之间审美风格差异认识的影响。作者指出，“色盲”话语倾向于夸大种族界限的渗透性，因为它没能解决在社会氛围中涉及的权力关系问题，这种氛围中对种族问题的回避常被用来压制非裔美国人对爵士乐意义的观点。因此，这里提到的“权力关系”是为了说明在种族动态中，“色盲”观点的不足，尤其是在它没充分考虑和解决种族间权力差异和社会结构上的种族分层问题。选B选项。

其他选项：
help summarize an argument that the author wishes to refute
作者并不是在总结某个反对观点，而是指出 color blindness 的问题。原文没有“总结对手观点并反驳”的意思，而是直接批评这种 discourse 的不足。

demonstrate a link between social and aesthetic factors affecting jazz musicians
虽然文中提到社会氛围和种族问题，但这里“power relationships”是批评 color blindness 的不足，不是要证明社会和美学的联系。

emphasize the commitment of some jazz musicians to a particular view of jazz
原文提到一些黑人音乐家强调差异（differences），但“power relationships”这一点不是用来说明音乐家的 commitment，而是批评 color blindness 的忽略。

cite evidence to support a claim about stylistic developments within jazz in the 1950s
原文提到 stylistic similarities/differences，但“power relationships”完全是社会层面的，不是关于音乐风格发展的证据。

qs.stem: The passage suggests that some authors writing in 1950s jazz periodicals
qs.zh: 这段文字表明，一些在20世纪50年代的爵士乐期刊上写作的作者

opts.t: promoted a view of jazz that would remain influential well beyond the 1950s
opts.cn: 宣扬了一种爵士乐的观点，这种观点在20世纪50年代之后仍将具有影响力

opts.t: failed to grasp the full extent of the similarities between Black and White jazz musicians
opts.cn: 未能充分理解黑人和白人爵士音乐家之间的相似之处

opts.t: were sincere in their belief that race played no role in shaping the aesthetic aspects of jazz
opts.cn: 他们真诚地相信种族在塑造爵士乐的美学方面没有起到任何作用

opts.t: criticized the general public's obliviousness to the reality of racial boundaries within jazz
opts.h: criticized the general public's obliviousness to the reality of racial boundaries within jazz
opts.cn: 批评公众对爵士乐中种族界限的现实视而不见

opts.t: claimed that the differences between Black and White musicians had been underestimated
opts.cn: 声称黑人和白人音乐家之间的差异被低估了

qs.label: C
qs.why:
“While the expression of color-blind sentiments was not necessarily disingenuous, structural racial stratification remained powerful beyond the bandstand.” 这句话暗示，尽管表达“色盲”情感可能是真诚的，但是种族结构的分层在更广泛的社会和音乐领域仍然具有强大的影响力。这表明了一些作者真诚地认为种族在爵士乐的美学构成中并无重要角色（尽管这种观点可能没有考虑到更广泛的社会和种族动态），对应C选项。

其他选项：
promoted a view of jazz that would remain influential well beyond the 1950s
文中没有提到这种“色盲”（color blindness）观点是否在1950年代之后持续影响爵士乐界。

failed to grasp the full extent of the similarities between Black and White jazz musicians
文章没有提到作者是否完全理解这些相似性，讨论的焦点在于“色盲”的概念如何夸大种族界限的渗透性，而不是作者对相似性的理解。

criticized the general public's obliviousness to the reality of racial boundaries within jazz
文中没有提到这些作者批评公众，相反，文章讨论的是“色盲”言论的影响，而不是这些作者对公众的批评。

claimed that the differences between Black and White musicians had been underestimated
文章指出一些非洲裔美国爵士音乐家后来强调差异，但并没有提到这些“色盲”作者有这样的主张。

html: Snow algae, the most prolific and colorful microbial species colonizing snow and ice surfaces, have been studied in many polar and alpine settings. As part of their life cycle and as a mechanism of protection from high irradiation, snow algae species produce red pigments (carotenoids). Through this protective reaction, algal blooms color snow and ice surfaces and cause a darkening of glacial surfaces, which in turn leads to a decrease in surface albedo (a measure of the reflectivity of the Earth’s surface). Such a decrease of albedo may speed up melting processes and is of special interest in Iceland, where glaciers are retreating fast and where albedo is also affected by the presence of volcanic dust and ash on snow and ice surfaces.
zh:
①雪藻是在冰雪表面定殖的数量最多、色彩最丰富的微生物物种，在许多极地和高山环境中都对其进行过研究。
②作为其生命周期的一部分和抵御高辐照的一种机制，雪藻物种会产生红色色素（类胡萝卜素）。
③通过这种保护反应，藻类大量繁殖使冰雪表面着色，导致冰川表面变暗，进而导致表面反照率（衡量地球表面反射率的指标）下降。
④反照率的降低可能会加速冰川融化过程，这一点在冰岛特别引人关注，因为那里的冰川正在快速后退，冰雪表面的火山尘埃和火山灰也会影响反照率。

qs.stem: It can be inferred that the presence of volcanic dust and ash on snow surfaces in Iceland is likely to
qs.zh: 可以推断，冰岛雪面上的火山尘埃和火山灰的存在很可能会

opts.t: offset any decrease in albedo caused by snow algae
opts.cn: 抵消雪藻造成的反照率下降

opts.t: slow the growth of snow algal species in the affected area
opts.cn: 减缓受影响地区雪藻物种的生长速度

opts.t: lead to changes in the life cycle of local snow algal species
opts.cn: 导致当地雪藻物种的生命周期发生变化

opts.t: have an effect on glacial melting similar to that of snow algae
opts.cn: 对冰川融化产生与雪藻类似的影响

opts.t: increase the number of microbial species colonizing Iceland’s snow surfaces
opts.cn: 增加冰岛雪地表面微生物物种的数量

qs.label: D
qs.why:
文章提到，雪藻通过产生红色色素来保护自己免受高辐射的伤害，这导致冰川表面变暗，从而降低了冰川表面的反照率（albedo）。降低的反照率可能会加速冰川的融化过程。文章还提到，冰岛冰川退化快速，且其反照率也受到雪和冰表面上火山灰和尘埃的影响。这表明火山灰和尘埃可能也会导致类似雪藻那样的降低反照率，从而加速冰川的融化。

其他选项：
offset any decrease in albedo caused by snow algae：文章并未提供足够信息来支持火山灰和尘埃会抵消雪藻导致的反照率降低。
slow the growth of snow algal species in the affected area：文章中没有提到火山灰和尘埃对雪藻生长速度的影响。
lead to changes in the life cycle of local snow algal species：文章中没有涉及火山灰和尘埃对雪藻生命周期的具体影响。
increase the number of microbial species colonizing Iceland’s snow surfaces：文章没有讨论火山灰和尘埃如何影响冰岛雪面微生物种类的数量。

html: There is a long-standing historical presumption that social custom during the early years of the United States forbade women from public speaking. In fact, though, the standard mode of education of the 1790s and early 1800s, which emphasized oral recitation and performance, taught girls that educated and well-spoken women had an important role to play in American society. By depicting skilled speech as a necessary talent for women in a civilized society, elocutionary education encouraged a certain degree of female ambition and even political involvement. Transmitted via standard, inexpensive schoolbooks, this message reached virtually all who read schoolbooks or attended schools. This environment did not last long, however: even by the 1810s, attitudes about women's education had changed considerably.
zh:
①美国早年的社会习俗禁止妇女在公共场合演讲，这是一个由来已久的历史假设。
②但事实上，17 世纪 90 年代和 1800 年代早期的标准教育模式强调口头朗诵和表演，让女孩们懂得受过教育、能说会道的女性在美国社会中扮演着重要角色。
③通过将娴熟的语言表达能力描绘成文明社会中女性必备的才能，口才教育在一定程度上鼓励了女性的抱负甚至政治参与。
④这种信息通过标准、廉价的教科书传播，几乎覆盖了所有阅读教科书或上学的人。
⑤然而，这种环境并没有持续太久：即使到了1810年代，人们对女性教育的态度也发生了很大变化。

qs.stem: The author discusses "the standard mode of education" in order to
qs.zh: 作者讨论了 "标准教育模式"，是为了

opts.t: explain why attitudes toward women's participation in public speaking changed over a particular period of time
opts.h: explain why attitudes toward women's participation in public speaking changed over a particular period of time
opts.cn: 解释为什么在特定时期对女性参与公共演讲的态度会发生变化

opts.t: suggest that early American attitudes toward women's participation in public discourse were inherently contradictory
opts.h: suggest that early American attitudes toward women's participation in public discourse were inherently contradictory
opts.cn: 指出美国早期对妇女参与公共演讲的态度存在内在矛盾

opts.t: identify a possible basis for the long-held belief that women in the early United States were discouraged from public speaking
opts.cn: 为人们长期以来认为美国早期妇女不愿意在公共场合演讲的观点找到可能的依据

opts.t: provide evidence tending to undermine a widely held view about women in early American society
opts.cn: 提供证据，削弱人们对美国早期社会妇女的普遍看法

opts.t: illustrate how social custom in the early years of the United States prevented women from public speaking
opts.cn: 说明美国早期的社会习俗是如何阻止妇女公开演讲的

qs.label: D
qs.why:
原文先提出一个“长期的历史性预设”（女性被社会习俗禁止公开演讲），随后用“当时的标准教育模式”来反驳这一预设：该教育“强调口头背诵与表演”，并教女生“受过教育、口才好的女性在社会中很重要”，还把“熟练的言说”描绘成“女性在文明社会中的必要才能”，“鼓励……甚至政治参与”（“which emphasized oral recitation and performance… ‘educated and well-spoken women had an important role’… ‘skilled speech as a necessary talent’… ‘encouraged… even political involvement’）。
作者讨论“the standard mode of education”是为提供证据去削弱/推翻那个广泛流传的看法，对应D选项。

其他选项：
explain why attitudes toward women's participation in public speaking changed over a particular period of time
原文只指出到 1810s“态度已发生相当大的变化”（“even by the 1810s, attitudes… had changed considerably.”），并没解释原因；讨论教育模式的段落是在说明早期事实以反驳预设，而不是解释变化的因果。

suggest that early American attitudes toward women's participation in public discourse were inherently contradictory
文中是“先给出预设，随后用事实纠正”，不是说社会同时持有自相矛盾的态度；关键转折是“In fact, though, the standard mode of education…”，这是纠偏而不是“内在矛盾”。

identify a possible basis for the long-held belief that women in the early United States were discouraged from public speaking
教育模式提供的是反例而不是该信念的根据：它“emphasized oral recitation and performance”，并把口才当作“necessary talent”，明显不支持“被劝阻”的预设。

illustrate how social custom in the early years of the United States prevented women from public speaking
与原文相反：教育实际“encouraged… even political involvement”，并通过“standard, inexpensive schoolbooks”广泛传播（“this message reached virtually all…”）。这不是“阻止”，而是促进/鼓励。

qs.stem: The author of the passage would most likely agree with which of the following statements about the emphasis on "oral recitation and performance"?
qs.zh: 关于强调 "口头朗诵和表演"，这段话的作者最有可能同意以下哪种说法？

opts.t: It reflected the assumption that women were especially well suited for public speaking.
opts.cn: 它反映了一种假设，即女性特别适合在公共场合演讲。

opts.t: It was based on an ideal of equal educational opportunity for men and women.
opts.cn: 它基于男女教育机会平等的理想。

opts.t: It was more prominent as an element in the education of young women than in the education of young men.
opts.cn: 在对年轻女性的教育中，它比在对年轻男性的教育中更为突出。

opts.t: It was more pronounced in school curricula in some parts of the country than in others.
opts.cn: 在全国一些地区的学校课程中，它比其他地区更为突出。

opts.t: It fostered an ambition in some young women to participate in political activities.
opts.cn: 它培养了一些年轻女性参与政治活动的雄心。

qs.label: E
qs.why:
原文第三句提到“By depicting skilled speech as a necessary talent for women in a civilized society, elocutionary education encouraged a certain degree of female ambition and even political involvement.” 这种教育鼓励了女性的野心，甚至是政治参与，对应E选项。

其他选项：
It reflected the assumption that women were especially well suited for public speaking.
原文中没有提到社会普遍认为女性特别适合公共演讲，而是强调了通过教育在女性中培养出这样的能力。
It was based on an ideal of equal educational opportunity for men and women.
原文并没有提及这种教育是基于男女平等的教育机会的理想，仅说明了女性接受此种教育的情况。
It was more prominent as an element in the education of young women than in the education of young men.
虽然原文专注于女性的教育，但没有明确比较女性和男性在接受口语表达和表演方面的教育是否有所不同。
It was more pronounced in school curricula in some parts of the country than in others.
原文中未提到这种教育模式在国家不同地区的差异。

html: The scandal caused by Gustave Courbet's 1850 painting A Burial at Ornans cannot be attributed to its subject— other artists' depictions of regional life had gained acceptance in Paris art circles—or to critics' assessments of Courbet's skill. Rather, by representing an ordinary burial in a provincial town on the large scale normally reserved for prestigious history paintings, Courbet had departed from a polite kind of Realism that had only recently become acceptable, where both the subject—virtuous peasant life—and the dimensions were modest. Courbet sought to do something more ambitious than a painter like Leleux, who depicted everyday life faithfully and without exaggeration: Courbet wished to paint his contemporaries with the seriousness normally reserved for kings and heroes.
zh:
①GC 1850 年的画作《奥尔南的葬礼》（A Burial at Ornans）引起的丑闻不能归咎于它的主题--其他艺术家对地区生活的描绘已在巴黎艺术界获得认可--也不能归咎于评论家对 C 技巧的评价。
②相反，C 用通常为著名历史画保留的大尺幅表现了一个外省小镇的普通葬礼，从而摆脱了一种最近才被接受的彬彬有礼的现实主义风格，这种风格的主题--淳朴的农民生活和尺寸都很适中。
③C 试图完成比 L 这样的画家更具雄心的事业 —— L 忠实且不加夸张地描绘日常生活: 而 C 则希望以通常仅用于描绘国王与英雄的庄重笔触，去刻画他所处时代的普通人。

qs.stem: The author of the passage mentions "other artists' depictions of regional life" primarily in order to
qs.zh: 作者提到 “其他艺术家对地区生活的描绘”，主要是为了

opts.t: explain how Courbet first conceived the idea for A Burial at Ornans
opts.cn: 解释 C 最初是如何构思《奥尔南的葬礼》这幅画的

opts.t: discount a particular explanation for the reception of Courbet's A Burial at Ornans
opts.h: discount a particular explanation for the reception of Courbet's A Burial at Ornans
opts.cn: 否定一种关于 C 的《奥尔南的葬礼》所受评价的特定解释

opts.t: suggest that Courbet's A Burial at Ornans changed the way his contemporaries thought about the subject matter of paintings
opts.h: suggest that Courbet's A Burial at Ornans changed the way his contemporaries thought about the subject matter of paintings
opts.cn: 暗示 C 的《奥尔南的葬礼》改变了同时代人对绘画题材的看法

opts.t: contrast Courbet's skill as a painter with that of other artists who depicted everyday subjects
opts.h: contrast Courbet's skill as a painter with that of other artists who depicted everyday subjects
opts.cn: 将 C 的绘画技巧与其他描绘日常题材的艺术家进行对比

opts.t: demonstrate that certain kinds of subject matter were considered unappealing in Paris art circles during Courbet's lifetime
opts.h: demonstrate that certain kinds of subject matter were considered unappealing in Paris art circles during Courbet's lifetime
opts.cn: 说明在 C 的生前，某些题材在巴黎的艺术圈中被认为缺乏吸引力

qs.label: B
qs.why:
作者说“不能归因于主题”，因为其他画家的地区题材作品早就被接受了。也就是说，提到“other artists' depictions”就是为了排除“题材”作为丑闻原因的解释，对应B选项。

其他选项：
explain how Courbet first conceived the idea for A Burial at Ornans
原文完全没说 Courbet 是“受其他画家启发”才画的。提到别的画家只是为了说明题材不是问题。

suggest that Courbet's A Burial at Ornans changed the way his contemporaries thought about the subject matter of paintings
原文没说这幅画改变了 contemporaries 的看法，只说这种题材本来就被接受了（"had gained acceptance"），所以并不是 Courbet 改变了别人。

contrast Courbet's skill as a painter with that of other artists who depicted everyday subjects
原文明确说“不能归因于评论家对 Courbet 技艺的评价”（"or to critics' assessments of Courbet's skill"），所以并不是拿技能作比较。

demonstrate that certain kinds of subject matter were considered unappealing in Paris art circles during Courbet's lifetime
原文说的是已经被接受（"had gained acceptance"），而不是“unappealing”。

qs.stem: The passage suggests which of the following about those who were scandalized by Courbet's A Burial at Ornans ?
qs.zh: 文章暗示了那些对 C 的《奥尔南的葬礼》感到震惊的人的哪些方面？

opts.t: They might have been more accepting of the painting if they had found its depiction of an ordinary subject to be more accurate in its details.
opts.cn: 如果他们发现这幅画对一个普通主题的描绘在细节上更加准确，他们可能会更容易接受这幅画。

opts.t: They felt that an ordinary burial in a provincial town was not an appropriate subject for an artist to depict.
opts.cn: 他们认为，一个外省小镇的普通葬礼并不适合艺术家描绘。

opts.t: They found Courbet's depictions of regional life to be clumsy in comparison with depictions of such scenes by some earlier artists.
opts.h: They found Courbet's depictions of regional life to be clumsy in comparison with depictions of such scenes by some earlier artists.
opts.cn: 他们认为 C 对地区生活的描绘与一些早期艺术家对此类场景的描绘相比显得笨拙。

opts.t: They were disturbed by a perceived discrepancy between the painting's subject matter and the way in which Courbet depicted it.
opts.h: They were disturbed by a perceived discrepancy between the painting's subject matter and the way in which Courbet depicted it.
opts.cn: 他们认为这幅画的主题与 C 的描绘方式之间存在差异，这让他们感到不安。

opts.t: They came to appreciate the painting once they understood why Courbet chose to approach his subject as he did.
opts.cn: 当他们理解 C 为何选择这样的表现手法后，他们才开始欣赏这幅画。

qs.label: D
qs.why:
文章第二句提到“by representing an ordinary burial in a provincial town on the large scale normally reserved for prestigious history paintings, Courbet had departed from a polite kind of Realism...”，这表明人们对这幅画感到震惊是因为主题的普通性与作品规模的矛盾。普通的葬礼被大规模地呈现出来，这种规模通常是为历史画保留的。选D选项。

其他选项：
They might have been more accepting of the painting if they had found its depiction of an ordinary subject to be more accurate in its details.
文章没有提到人们对绘画的细节准确性有任何批评。

They felt that an ordinary burial in a provincial town was not an appropriate subject for an artist to depict.
文章提到其他描绘地方生活的艺术作品已被接受（“other artists' depictions of regional life had gained acceptance”），因此这并不是他们反对的原因。

They found Courbet's depictions of regional life to be clumsy in comparison with depictions of such scenes by some earlier artists.
文章没有提到人们认为 C 的技巧拙劣，实际上“critics' assessments of Courbet's skill”并不是问题。

They came to appreciate the painting once they understood why Courbet chose to approach his subject as he did.
文章没有提到观众后来接受了这幅画，也没有提到他们理解了 C 的动机后改变了看法。

html: That nineteenth-century European women sculptors seldom saw their work displayed in the most prestigious locations can be linked to the genres (portraits, mythological figures) and the formats (reliefs and life size or smaller-scale sculptures) in which they worked. But what was cause and what was effect of these women’s limited access to public space? Women sculptors rarely received commissions for the highest genre in the hierarchy of public sculpture: the huge historical equestrian monument in a public square. Women made some life-size statues, but these were seldom placed on high pedestals in open public spaces. Public sculptures by women usually do not seem to have been designed for the monumentality of public space; they are often, essentially, interior sculptures that may or may not have been placed outside.
zh:
①19世纪的欧洲女雕塑家很少看到她们的作品在最著名的地方展出，这与她们工作的类型（肖像、神话人物）和形式（浮雕和真人大小或更小规模的雕塑）有关。
②但是，这些女性的作品进入公共空间受到限制的原因和影响是什么呢？
③女性雕塑家很少接受公共雕塑中最高类型的委托：公共广场上巨大的历史骑手纪念碑。
④女性们制作了一些真人大小的雕像，但这些雕像很少放在开放公共空间的高基座上。
⑤女性的公共雕塑通常似乎不是为公共空间的纪念而设计的；它们通常本质上是室内雕塑，可能放在外面，也可能不放在外面。

qs.stem: The passage suggests which of the following about “smaller-scale sculptures”?
qs.zh: 这篇文章关于“小规模雕塑”暗示了以下哪一项？

opts.t: They depicted mythological figures more frequently than did life-size sculptures.
opts.cn: 他们描绘神话人物的频率比真人大小的雕塑要高。

opts.t: They were more often produced by female sculptors than by male sculptors.
opts.cn: 女性雕塑家的作品比男性雕塑家的作品多。

opts.t: They were often designed with the intention that they would be displayed outdoors.
opts.cn: 它们的设计意图通常是在户外展示。

opts.t: They tended to be ranked higher in the hierarchy of sculptural genres than reliefs.
opts.cn: 在雕塑体裁的层次上，它们往往比浮雕排得更高。

opts.t: They were generally not considered suitable for display on high pedestals in public spaces.
opts.cn: 一般它们不被认为适合在公共场所的高基座上展示。

qs.label: E
qs.why:
原文写道：“Women made some life-size statues, but these were seldom placed on high pedestals in open public spaces. Public sculptures by women usually do not seem to have been designed for the monumentality of public space; they are often, essentially, interior sculptures that may or may not have been placed outside.”
由此可见，不论是“life-size”还是“smaller-scale”作品，女性雕塑家的作品都“seldom”被置于“high pedestals in open public spaces”，也就是说，这些较小尺寸的雕塑通常不被认为适合在公共空间的高基座上展示，对应E选项。

其他选项：
They depicted mythological figures more frequently than did life-size sculptures.
原文虽然提到女性雕塑家所用的题材包括“portraits, mythological figures”，但并没比较“smaller-scale sculptures”与“life-size sculptures”在题材上的比例或频率。

They were more often produced by female sculptors than by male sculptors.
文章没有涉及性别制作频率的对比，论述焦点在于女性作品的展示场所和规模，而不是“谁制作得更多”。

They were often designed with the intention that they would be displayed outdoors.
原文信息正好相反：“Public sculptures by women usually do not seem to have been designed for the monumentality of public space; they are often, essentially, interior sculptures…”，说明这些作品多为室内设计，而不是专为户外展示。

They tended to be ranked higher in the hierarchy of sculptural genres than reliefs.
文章提到“the highest genre in the hierarchy of public sculpture”是“大型历史骑马纪念碑”，并没说“smaller-scale sculptures”在题材等级上优于“reliefs”。题材等级讨论的是像“portrait”“mythological figures”“historical monument”这样的大类，不涉及尺寸格式之间的等级比较。

qs.stem: The passage suggests which of the following about the “life-size statues”?
qs.zh: 这篇文章关于“真人大小的雕像”暗示了以下哪一项？

opts.t: They were often considered too large for interior spaces but not sufficiently prestigious to appear in public squares.
opts.cn: 它们通常被认为对于室内空间来说太大，但没有足够的声望出现在公共广场上。

opts.t: They were typical of the work of women sculptors because women sculptors frequently received commissions for such works.
opts.cn: 这些作品是女雕塑家作品的典型代表，因为女雕塑家经常收到此类作品的委托。

opts.t: Some of them depicted subjects that would conventionally have been depicted in formats smaller than life size.
opts.cn: 其中一些描绘的主题通常会以小于真人大小的形式描绘。

opts.t: Most of them were considered to fall outside the category of the highest genre in the hierarchy of public sculpture.
opts.cn: 它们中的大多数被认为不属于公共雕塑等级中最高流派的范畴。

opts.t: Most of them were designed by sculptors who intended that they be displayed in open public spaces.
opts.cn: 这些雕塑大多是由雕塑家设计的，他们希望它们能在开放的公共空间中展出。

qs.label: D
qs.why:
加粗部分所在句说这些女性制作的真人大小的雕像很少被放置在开放的公共空间的高基座上，前句说女性雕塑家很少接受公共雕塑中最高类型的委托：公共广场上巨大的历史骑手纪念碑, 推出"女性制作的真人大小的雕像"不属于" the highest genre in the hierarchy of public sculpture", 对应D选项。

其他选项：
They were often considered too large for interior spaces but not sufficiently prestigious to appear in public squares.
原文并没提到 “对室内空间而言过大”。文中只是说这些真人大小的雕像“本质上是室内雕塑”，没有暗示它们超出了室内空间的承受范围。

They were typical of the work of women sculptors because women sculptors frequently received commissions for such works.
原文只说“Women made some life-size statues”（女性确实制作过一些真人大小雕像），并没说她们“经常”受到此类委托。而且文章强调她们很少获得最高级别的公共雕塑委托。

Some of them depicted subjects that would conventionally have been depicted in formats smaller than life size.
原文没说这些真人大小雕像所表现的题材是否不符合常规大小；文章关注的是它们的显示位置和体量，而不是题材与常规尺寸的对比。

Most of them were designed by sculptors who intended that they be displayed in open public spaces.
与原文相反，文中明确说这些作品“并不为公共空间的宏伟感而设计”，而是“本质上是室内雕塑”。

html: It was only in the 1990s that marine scientists became aware of shifting baseline syndrome—the problem of establishing the size of historical populations of marine life in a given species or community. Just what, for example, is a healthy number of red snapper in the Gulf of Mexico? As one fisheries biologist notes, each generation of scientists takes as a baseline “the size and species composition that occurred at the beginning of [that generation's] career.” The result is that, over time, the expectation of the natural number of fish gets smaller and smaller. Eventually, the population is so small that even a modest environmental perturbation, or slightly more fishing, causes it to unexpectedly collapse.
zh:
①直到 20 世纪 90 年代，海洋科学家才意识到基线变化综合症--即确定特定物种或群落中海洋生物历史种群数量的问题。
②例如，墨西哥湾健康的红鲷鱼数量是多少？
③正如一位渔业生物学家所指出的，每一代科学家都将“[那一代人]职业生涯开始时的规模和物种组成 ”作为基准。
④结果是，随着时间的推移，对鱼类自然数量的预期越来越小。
⑤最终，种群数量变得如此之少，以至于即使是轻微的环境扰动，或者稍微多捕一点鱼，都会导致种群意外崩溃。

qs.stem: Of the following, which is the most likely outcome of not being aware of shifting baseline syndrome?
qs.zh: 在以下几种情况中，哪一种是不意识到基线变化综合征的最有可能的结果？

opts.t: Exaggerating the threat that overfishing poses to marine species generally
opts.cn: 普遍夸大过度捕捞对海洋物种造成的威胁

opts.t: Failing to see how a healthy fish population is a function of both the number of fish and the number of species in a community
opts.cn: 没有认识到健康的鱼类种群是一个群落中鱼类数量和物种数量的函数

opts.t: Being pessimistic as to whether a short-term decline in certain fish species can be reversed
opts.cn: 对某些鱼类物种的短期减少能否逆转持悲观态度

opts.t: Assuming that the declining number of fish species in a community is the result of human activity rather than natural fluctuations
opts.cn: 假定群落中鱼类物种数量的减少是人类活动而非自然波动的结果

opts.t: Treating historical accounts of extremely abundant marine life with skepticism
opts.cn: 对历史上关于海洋生物极其丰富的记载持怀疑态度

qs.label: E
qs.why:
题目讨论了shifting baseline syndrome（基线漂移综合症）的概念，即每一代科学家都以他们职业生涯开始时的生物种群规模为基线，导致随着时间推移，科学家对鱼类自然数量的期望变得越来越低（“the expectation of the natural number of fish gets smaller and smaller”）。因此，未能意识到这种基线漂移的最可能结果是，科学家会怀疑历史上有关鱼类数量非常多的记录，即，可能会认为过去的记录夸大了鱼类数量，对应E选项。

其他选项：
Exaggerating the threat that overfishing poses to marine species generally
文章没有提到科学家夸大过度捕捞的威胁，反而是基线漂移导致对鱼类数量期望逐渐降低。原文说的是期望变得越来越小，而不是威胁被夸大。
Failing to see how a healthy fish population is a function of both the number of fish and the number of species in a community
原文并没有讨论健康种群的复杂性。
Being pessimistic as to whether a short-term decline in certain fish species can be reversed
文章没有提到科学家对短期下降的看法，讨论的是基线漂移和长期对鱼类数量的错误估计，而不是短期悲观。
Assuming that the declining number of fish species in a community is the result of human activity rather than natural fluctuations
文章没有提到自然波动或人为活动的对比。

html: In their neglect of women beekeepers, the records of the Western Apiary Society, founded in England in 1799 to promote the popularization of scientific, humane beekeeping practices, contrast with manuals published before the Society ’ s founding. Warder, for example, routinely analyzed the activities of the “ Country Bee Mistresses, ” and Thorley ’ s Melisselogia counted 43 women out of 461 subscribers. The Society ’ s bias provides an early illustration of the masculinization of beekeeping in public discourse. The situation would repeat in the late nineteenth century when more beekeeping societies spread across the country. Current evidence does not support the claim that pre-1800 English beekeeping was a primarily female practice, but over representation of men within the realms of public innovation and popularization surely directed information about beekeeping toward a disproportionately male audience.
zh:
①在忽视女性养蜂人的情况下，西方养蜂协会(成立于1799年，旨在促进科学、人道养蜂实践的普及)的记录，与协会成立前出版的手册形成鲜明对比。
②例如，W经常分析“乡村蜜蜂妇女”的活动，T的M统计了461名订阅者中的43名女性。
③该协会的偏见为公众话语中养蜂的男性化提供了早期的例证。
④这种情况会在十九世纪末重演，那时更多的养蜂协会遍布全国。
⑤目前的证据不支持1800年以前英国养蜂主要是女性的说法，但在公共创新和普及领域中，男性的过度代表肯定会将养蜂的信息倒向不成比例的男性受众。

qs.stem: According to the passage, which of the following was a trend in the public discourse of beekeeping during the nineteenth century?
qs.zh: 根据这篇文章，以下哪一项是19世纪公众讨论养蜂的趋势？

opts.t: An increase in focus on male beekeepers
opts.cn: 增加对男性养蜂人的关注

opts.t: An increase in debate about current beekeeping practices
opts.cn: 关于当前养蜂实践的争论增多

opts.t: An increase in emphasis on innovations in beekeeping techniques
opts.cn: 加强养蜂技术创新

qs.label: A
qs.why:
“masculinization of beekeeping in public discourse”（公共话语的男性化）
“The situation would repeat in the late nineteenth century”（十九世纪晚期重演）
“directed information … toward a disproportionately male audience”（信息导向过度男性化的受众）
这些都指向同一件事：公众讨论和信息传播，越来越偏向男性、面向男性受众。A选项正确。

其他选项：
An increase in debate about current beekeeping practices
原文提到的是“masculinization”“disproportionately male audience”，关注的是谁被代表、话语偏向谁，完全没有说有“更多争论（debate）”。

An increase in emphasis on innovations in beekeeping techniques
原文虽然提到 “public innovation and popularization”，但重点在于：这些领域里“over representation of men”，导致信息主要面向男性受众。
它讲的是谁在创新与普及的位置上、信息朝谁去，并不是说“越来越强调技术创新本身”。

qs.stem: According to the passage, which of the following is true regarding pre-1800 English beekeeping as compared with post-1800 English beekeeping?
qs.zh: 根据文章，与1800年后的英国养蜂相比, 以下哪一项关于1800年前的英国养蜂的描述正确？

opts.t: Manuals of beekeeping practices were more popular.
opts.cn: 养蜂手册更受欢迎。

opts.t: Manuals of beekeeping practices were less detailed.
opts.cn: 关于养蜂实践的手册不太详细。

opts.t: There were fewer beekeeping societies.
opts.cn: 养蜂协会较少。

opts.t: There was more debate regarding the practicality of humane beekeeping practices.
opts.cn: 关于人类养蜂做法的实用性有更多的辩论。

opts.t: There were more female beekeepers than male beekeepers.
opts.cn: 女性养蜂人多于男性养蜂人。

qs.label: C
qs.why:
文章首句提到“the records of the Western Apiary Society, founded in England in 1799...”，这暗示在1800年之前，养蜂协会的数量较少。此外，文章第四句提到 "The situation would repeat in the late nineteenth century when more beekeeping societies spread across the country."，说明在19世纪晚期有更多的养蜂协会出现，因此1800年之前的养蜂协会数量较少。

其他选项：
Manuals of beekeeping practices were more popular.
原文只说 1800 年以前有一些 manuals，比如 Warder 和 Thorley 的书，但没有比较这些 manuals 在 1800 前后谁“more popular”。“更受欢迎”是原文没有提到的信息。

Manuals of beekeeping practices were less detailed.
原文没有比较 manuals 的详细程度。它只是说早期 manuals 会提到女性养蜂者，比如 “Country Bee Mistresses” 和 “43 women out of 461 subscribers”，不是说内容更少或更不详细。

There was more debate regarding the practicality of humane beekeeping practices.
原文说 Western Apiary Society 是为了推广 “scientific, humane beekeeping practices”，但没有说 1800 年前后围绕 humane beekeeping 的“practicality（实用性）”有更多争论。

There were more female beekeepers than male beekeepers.
原文最后明确说：“Current evidence does not support the claim that pre-1800 English beekeeping was a primarily female practice.” 即，现有证据不支持“1800 年以前英国养蜂主要是女性实践”这个说法，更不能推出女性养蜂者比男性更多。

html: Agricultural historians theorize that farming originated when the pressures of growing populations or shrinking resources imposed the need to find new species to adapt for food. This hypothesis is supported by impressive work by anthropologists who have observed transitions to agriculture that happened in recent times. But, as an explanation for why agriculture arose in the first place, it seems ill matched to the facts of chronology. Extinctions—or even significant diminutions—in hunters’ prey species cannot be shown to have happened in any of the right places at any of the right times. Populations certainly grew in the most dedicated farming cultures—but, in most places, more probably as a consequence than as a cause.
zh:
①农业史学家认为，农耕起源于人口增长或资源减少的压力，人们需要寻找新的物种来适应食物的需要。
②人类学家通过观察近代向农业的过渡，得出了令人印象深刻的结论，从而支持了这一假设。
③但是，作为对农业产生原因的解释，它似乎与年代学的事实不符。
④狩猎者猎物物种的灭绝甚至大幅减少，都不能证明是在任何正确的时间发生在任何正确的地点。
⑤在最专注的农耕文化中，人口肯定会增长，但在大多数地方，这更可能是结果而不是原因。

qs.stem: The author would likely include which of the following evidence in the “facts of chronology”?
qs.zh: 作者可能会将以下哪项证据纳入 "年代学事实"？

opts.t: The number of centuries separating the earliest transitions to agriculture from those observed by anthropologists
opts.cn: 人类学家观察到的最早向农业过渡之间相隔的世纪数

opts.t: The earliest dates for which evidence of farming practices has been established
opts.cn: 农耕习俗证据确凿的最早日期

opts.t: The known dates, if any, of extinctions of prey species that formed an important part of the diet of ancient human societies
opts.cn: 构成古人类社会饮食重要组成部分的猎物物种灭绝的已知日期（如果有的话）

qs.label: B C
qs.why:
作者指出农业起源与“事实的年代顺序 (chronology)”不匹配：“as an explanation for why agriculture arose in the first place, it seems ill matched to the facts of chronology.”
这里的“chronology”指的是与农业出现的具体年代相关的证据。说明确立农业活动的最早证据的日期直接与作者讨论的“年代顺序”相关。选B选项。

原文提到，农业起源的假说无法证明在“正确的时间”和“正确的地点”出现过猎物物种的灭绝或减少：“Extinctions—or even significant diminutions—in hunters’ prey species cannot be shown to have happened in any of the right places at any of the right times.”
这个说法与猎物灭绝的日期相关，因此了解这些灭绝的确切时间也是“事实的年代顺序”之一。选C选项

其他选项：
The number of centuries separating the earliest transitions to agriculture from those observed by anthropologists
虽然文中提到人类学家观察到近代的农业转变，但作者提到的“chronology”指的是农业起源与相关事件（如物种灭绝）的时间不符，不是这些事件之间相隔了多少个世纪。

html: Tree frogs' ability to change color could serve as thermoregulation, since skin color affects the amount of absorbed solar energy. Some researchers reject this possibility because the skin of tree frogs is highly permeable to water. Although tree frogs vary in their solar absorbance, water loss increases with increased solar absorbance, thereby maintaining the tree frog's temperature at a constant level. This view, however, has been challenged by the discovery that some tree frogs change the permeability of their skin by secreting a waterproof coating. When a waterproof tree frog increases its solar absorbance by changing color, the waterproof coating will prevent the evaporative cooling effect seen in water-permeable species. Hence, a waterproof tree frog may be able to regulate its temperature by changing its solar absorbance via changing its skin color.
zh:
①树蛙的变色能力可能起到调节体温的作用，因为皮肤颜色会影响吸收的太阳能。
②一些研究人员否定了这种可能性，因为树蛙皮肤的透水性很强。
③虽然树蛙对太阳能的吸收能力各不相同，但随着对太阳能吸收能力的增加，水分流失也会增加，从而使树蛙的体温保持在一个恒定的水平。
④然而，人们发现有些树蛙会通过分泌一层防水涂层来改变皮肤的透水性，从而对这一观点提出了质疑。
⑤当防水树蛙通过改变颜色来增加对太阳光的吸收时，防水涂层就会阻止透水性物种的蒸发冷却效应。
⑥因此，防水树蛙可能能够通过改变皮肤颜色来改变对太阳光的吸收率，从而调节体温。

qs.stem: The hypothesis presented in the final sentence relies on which of the following assumptions?
qs.zh: 最后一句中提出的猜想基于以下哪项假设？

opts.t: That tree frogs may change the color of their skin as a camouflage strategy
opts.cn: 树蛙改变皮肤颜色可能是一种伪装策略

opts.t: That waterproof secretions do not counteract a tree frog's ability to change skin color
opts.h: That waterproof secretions do not counteract a tree frog's ability to change skin color
opts.cn: 防水分泌物不会抵消树蛙改变皮肤颜色的能力

opts.t: That the variation in solar absorbance among different tree frogs within a species is minimal
opts.cn: 同一物种中不同树蛙的太阳吸收率差异很小

opts.t: That some species of water-permeable tree frogs seem better adapted to variation in solar absorbance than do other species
opts.cn: 某些种类的透水树蛙似乎比其他种类更能适应太阳吸收率的变化

opts.t: That tree frogs are not able to regulate their temperature by periodic immersion in water
opts.cn: 树蛙无法通过定期浸泡在水中来调节体温

qs.label: B
qs.why:
最后一句的假设说：防水树蛙可能能够通过改变皮肤颜色来改变对太阳光的吸收率，从而调节体温。
这意味着，该假设依赖于防水分泌物不会妨碍树蛙改变皮肤颜色的能力，对应B选项。如果防水分泌物确实影响了树蛙改变皮肤颜色的能力，那么这种调节体温的机制就不会有效。

其他选项：
That tree frogs may change the color of their skin as a camouflage strategy
与体温调节无关，题干没提“伪装”

That the variation in solar absorbance among different tree frogs within a species is minimal
完全无关，原文关心的是一个树蛙能否改变自己的吸收率，不是个体间的差异

That some species of water-permeable tree frogs seem better adapted to variation in solar absorbance than do other species
这是关于透水型树蛙之间的比较，与结论中防水型树蛙的能力无关

That tree frogs are not able to regulate their temperature by periodic immersion in water
即使它们也能用泡水调节体温，并不影响变色调节体温这个结论的可能性，这不是必要的解释

html: Before feminist literary criticism emerged in the 1970s, the nineteenth-century United States writer Fanny Fern was regarded by most critics (when considered at all) as a prototype of weepy sentimentalism—a pious, insipid icon of conventional American culture. Feminist reclamations of Fern, by contrast, emphasize her nonsentimental qualities, particularly her sharply humorous social criticism. Most feminist scholars find it difficult to reconcile Fern’s sardonic social critiques with her effusive celebrations of many conventional values. Attempting to resolve this contradiction, Harris concludes that Fern employed flowery rhetoric strategically to disguise her subversive goals beneath apparent conventionality. However, Tompkins proposes an alternative view of sentimentality itself, suggesting that sentimental writing could serve radical, rather than only conservative ends by swaying readers emotionally, moving them to embrace social change.
zh:
①在 20 世纪 70 年代女性主义文学批评兴起之前，19 世纪美国女作家FF被大多数评论家视为哭泣式感伤主义的原型--传统美国文化中虔诚、平淡的代表。
②相比之下，女权主义对FF的评价则强调她的非感伤特质，尤其是她尖锐幽默的社会批判。
③大多数女权主义学者认为，FF尖刻的社会批判与她对许多传统价值观的赞美难以调和。
④为了解决这一矛盾，H得出结论认为，FF战略性地使用了华丽的辞藻，将她的颠覆性目标掩盖在表面的传统性之下。
⑤然而，T对多愁善感本身提出了另一种看法，认为多愁善感的写作可以通过动摇读者的情感，促使他们接受社会变革，从而达到激进而非保守的目的。

qs.stem: It can be inferred that the author of the passage mentions Fern’s “sharply humorous social criticism” primarily in order to
qs.zh: 可以推断，作者提到FF "尖锐幽默的社会批判"，主要是为了

opts.t: contrast Fern’s apparent intentions with the impression her writing made on Harris
opts.cn: 将FF的明显意图与她的写作给H留下的印象进行对比

opts.t: suggest that many feminist critics have attributed to Fern intentions that she may not have had
opts.cn: 表明许多女权主义批评家将她可能没有的意图归咎于FF

opts.t: identify an aspect of Fern’s writing that strikes some scholars as incompatible with other attributes of her writing
opts.cn: 指出FF写作中令一些学者感到与其写作的其他特征不相容的一个方面

opts.t: help account for the effect Fern's writing had on critics of her own time
opts.h: help account for the effect Fern's writing had on critics of her own time
opts.cn: 帮助解释FF的写作对当时评论家的影响

opts.t: identify the aspects of Fern's writing for which she was primarily known prior to the 1970s
opts.h: identify the aspects of Fern's writing for which she was primarily known prior to the 1970s
opts.cn: 指出 20 世纪 70 年代之前FF的写作主要以哪些方面著称

qs.label: C
qs.why:
“Most feminist scholars find it difficult to reconcile Fern’s sardonic social critiques with her effusive celebrations of many conventional values.”这些学者认为Fern的尖锐幽默与其他写作特质不相符，造成了一种矛盾。即，女性主义学者难以将Fern的讽刺社会批评与她对许多传统价值观的热情赞扬调和起来，对应C选项。

其他选项:
contrast Fern’s apparent intentions with the impression her writing made on Harris
提到“sharply humorous social criticism”发生在引出“女权重评”与“难以调和”的对比处，并不是拿 Fern 的“意图”去对照 Harris 的“印象”。关于 Harris 的内容在后文，而且是“Harris concludes that Fern employed flowery rhetoric strategically…”（Harris 的结论/解释），并不是前面那个提及的主要目的。

suggest that many feminist critics have attributed to Fern intentions that she may not have had
文中没有明确表示这些女性主义学者给Fern加上了她可能没有的意图，而是讨论了她的写作风格和目的。

help account for the effect Fern's writing had on critics of her own time
作者谈“当时的评论家”（女权批评出现之前）时说的是“weepy sentimentalism… pious, insipid icon of conventional American culture”。而“sharply humorous social criticism”是女权重评时期被强调的另一面，不是用来解释她同时代评论家的反应。

identify the aspects of Fern's writing for which she was primarily known prior to the 1970s
1970 年代之前她以“weepy sentimentalism… pious, insipid icon of conventional American culture”著称；而“sharply humorous social criticism”恰恰是1970s 后女权重评强调的内容，不是她此前“主要为人所知”的方面。

qs.stem: It can be inferred from the passage that Tompkins would be most likely to agree with which of the following about the critics mentioned in the passage?
qs.zh: 可以从文章中推断出，在以下关于文中提到的批评家的观点中，T最有可能同意哪项？

opts.t: They accurately characterize the overall result Fern is aiming to achieve.
opts.cn: 他们准确地表达了F所希望实现的整体结果。

opts.t: They are not as dismissive of Fern as some feminist critics have suggested.
opts.cn: 他们没有像一些女权主义批评家所暗示的那样对F持轻视态度。

opts.t: They exaggerate the extent to which Fern intended her writing to serve a social purpose.
opts.cn: 他们夸大了F写作旨在实现社会目的的程度。

opts.t: They wrongly assume that sentimental must be a pejorative term.
opts.cn: 他们错误地认为情感化必然是一个贬义词。

opts.t: They fail to recognize the role that sentimental rhetoric plays to reader’s emotions.
opts.cn: 他们未能认识到情感修辞对读者情感的作用。

qs.label: E
qs.why:
第一句的评论家是1970 年前的大多数评论家，他们认为 Fanny Fern 是“weepy sentimentalism”——也就是“爱哭的、感伤的、平庸的”代表人物。

Tompkins 的观点出现在最后一句：sentimental writing could serve radical, rather than only conservative ends by swaying readers emotionally, moving them to embrace social change.
感伤的写作（sentimental writing）不仅仅是保守的，还可以推动社会变革（radical ends），因为它能打动读者情感，让他们接受社会变化。
换句话说，Tompkins 是在为 sentimental writing 正名，认为它可以是积极、有力量的。选E选项。


其他选项：
They accurately characterize the overall result Fern is aiming to achieve.
Tompkins 认为这些评论家没有准确理解 Fern 的写作目的，因为他们认为她的感伤风格意味着保守，而忽视了其中可能的激进诉求。

They are not as dismissive of Fern as some feminist critics have suggested.
文中没有提到“这些批评家是否轻视 Fern”的问题，更没有讨论他们的态度是不是“像别人说的那么轻视”。

They exaggerate the extent to which Fern intended her writing to serve a social purpose.
这句话反了。Tompkins 并不是说批评家“夸大了社会目的”，而是他们低估了感伤写作的社会潜力。

They wrongly assume that sentimental must be a pejorative term.
虽然他们对 sentimentality 看法偏负面，但文中没有说他们“错误地把 sentimental 当作贬义词”，而是说他们没认识到这种风格本身可以带来改变，这不是语言态度问题，而是对风格作用的理解问题。

html: In North America, crows have historically antagonized humans by ravaging corn crops, but advancing urbanization has recently made humans more tolerant of crows, and crows' wariness has accordingly diminished. The future demeanor of the American crow (Corvus brachyrhynchos) is suggested by intercontinental analogy to India's house crow (Corvus splendens), which has lived for many centuries in an essentially unarmed, animal-friendly, and densely populated culture. Its audacity extends to stealing food from street vendors and entering dwellings to remove food from the table. The extreme watchfulness of the American crow has grown out of a long history of persecution. As people treat crows with insouciance rather than aggression, less wariness results in reproductive success, and another kind of corvine conduct asserts itself.
zh:
①在北美洲，乌鸦曾因蹂躏玉米作物而与人类作对，但近来城市化的发展使人类对乌鸦更加宽容，乌鸦的警惕性也相应降低。
②美洲乌鸦（Corvus brachyrhynchos）未来的举止可以通过洲际类比印度的家鸦（Corvus splendens）得到启示，印度的家鸦已经在一个基本上没有武器、动物友好和人口稠密的文化中生活了许多世纪。
③它胆大妄为，从街头小贩那里偷窃食物，还进入民宅搬走餐桌上的食物。
④美国乌鸦的极度警惕是在长期的迫害中形成的。
⑤随着人们对乌鸦的冷漠而非攻击，乌鸦的警惕性降低，从而获得了繁殖的成功，乌鸦的另一种行为方式也逐渐形成。

qs.stem: The author implies which of the following about the "insouciance" mentioned in the passage?
qs.zh: 作者对文中提到的 "冷漠 "有以下哪种暗示？

opts.t: It reflects an advance in our understanding of crows' behavior.
opts.h: It reflects an advance in our understanding of crows' behavior.
opts.cn: 它反映了我们对乌鸦行为理解的进步。

opts.t: It has increased in one region of the world as urbanization has grown.
opts.cn: 随着城市化的发展，某个地区的满不在乎的风气日益增长。

opts.t: It is likely to increase in a particular region as farming in that region increases.
opts.cn: 随着农业的发展，它在某一地区的数量可能会增加。

opts.t: It reflects the influence of one culture's attitudes toward animals on those of another culture.
opts.h: It reflects the influence of one culture's attitudes toward animals on those of another culture.
opts.cn: 它反映了一种文化对动物的态度对另一种文化的影响。

opts.t: It can have a positive influence on a given species' reproductive success in some contexts but a negative effect in others.
opts.h: It can have a positive influence on a given species' reproductive success in some contexts but a negative effect in others.
opts.cn: 在某些情况下，它可能会对特定物种的繁殖成功率产生积极影响，但在另一些情况下则会产生消极影响。

qs.label: B
qs.why:
“As people treat crows with insouciance rather than aggression, less wariness results in reproductive success …”
过去：crows 被“persecution（迫害）”，所以“extreme watchfulness”；
现在：随着“advancing urbanization”，人类“more tolerant”；
结果：当人类以“insouciance（漫不经心、无敌意）”对待乌鸦，而不是攻击时，“less wariness results in reproductive success”。
也就是说，在人类对乌鸦不再敌对、变得宽松的环境下，这种态度会带来乌鸦“reproductive success”。
再看前文：“In North America … advancing urbanization has recently made humans more tolerant of crows”
说明这种态度变化发生在北美，并且是随着城市化增加而出现的。
可以推断：随着城市化增长，人类对乌鸦的“insouciance”在某个地区增加。对应 B选项。

其他选项：
It reflects an advance in our understanding of crows' behavior.
原文说的是态度变化（tolerant / insouciance），不是因为“理解更深入”，也没有提到科学认知进步。

It is likely to increase in a particular region as farming in that region increases.
原文恰恰说过去在农业环境中乌鸦“ravaging corn crops”，人类敌视它们；insouciance 是和“urbanization”相关，不是 farming 增加。

It reflects the influence of one culture's attitudes toward animals on those of another culture.
文章只是做“intercontinental analogy”对比印度与北美，没有说一种文化影响了另一种文化。

It can have a positive influence on a given species' reproductive success in some contexts but a negative effect in others.
原文只说 insouciance 导致“reproductive success”（正面效果），没有提到负面效果。这是无中生有的对比。

html: Because they accumulate in an ordered manner that records changes within a lake and its drainage basin, lake sediments are particularly valuable for reconstructing ancient climate conditions. Natural materials such as pollen grains, minerals, diatoms, and animal microfossils preserved in sediments can be used to infer past conditions as these materials are affected by environmental variables. Pollen grains composed of sporopollenin, for example, can be used to infer past vegetation shifts. Because both natural climate change and human agricultural practices can lead to changes in vegetation, however, differentiation of these effects using pollen alone is difficult. In many areas of Mesoamerica , for instance, changes in the relative abundance of pollen types after 1000 B.C. were highly influenced by human-induced land clearance.
zh:
①由于湖泊沉积物有序堆积，记录了湖泊及其流域内的变化，因此湖泊沉积物对重建古代气候条件特别有价值。
②保存在沉积物中的花粉粒、矿物、硅藻和动物微化石等天然材料可用于推断过去的状况，因为这些材料会受到环境变量的影响。
③例如，由孢粉蛋白组成的花粉粒可用于推断过去的植被变化。
④然而，由于自然气候变化和人类的农业生产方式都会导致植被变化，因此仅利用花粉很难区分这些影响。
⑤例如，在中美洲的许多地区，公元前 1000 年后花粉类型相对丰度的变化在很大程度上受到人类造成的土地清理的影响。

qs.stem: The author mentions “sporopollenin” primarily in order to
qs.zh: 作者提到 "S "主要是为了

opts.t: suggest that the conclusion set forth in the preceding sentence is overly general
opts.cn: 说明前一句的结论过于笼统

opts.t: support, by means of an illustration, an assertion made in the preceding sentence
opts.cn: 通过举例说明来支持前一句的论断

opts.t: introduce a concept for which a more specific example is given in the following sentence
opts.cn: 引入一个概念，并在下一句中给出更具体的例子

opts.t: identify a possible reason for the problem that is described in the following sentence
opts.cn: 找出下一句所述问题的可能原因

opts.t: give an example that appears to contradict a principle set forth in the preceding sentence
opts.cn: 举例说明似乎与前一句中提出的原则相矛盾的地方

qs.label: B
qs.why: 作者提到S主要是为了通过一个具体示例支持前一句中提出的一个断言。这个断言是关于湖泊沉积物中保存的自然材料（如花粉粒、矿物、硅藻和动物微化石）可以用来推断过去的环境条件，因为这些材料受环境变量的影响。作者用S这个例子来说明如何利用沉积物中的材料来推断古代气候条件。

qs.stem: Which of the following does the passage present as a reason that lake sediments are of particular value in the reconstruction of ancient climate conditions?
qs.zh: 以下哪项是该段文字认为湖泊沉积物在重建古代气候条件方面具有特殊价值的原因？

opts.t: They allow scientists to distinguish between naturally occurring and human-induced vegetation changes.
opts.cn: 湖泊沉积物使科学家能够区分自然发生的植被变化和人类引起的植被变化。

opts.t: They contain natural materials that are relatively unaffected by environmental variables during accumulation.
opts.cn: 湖泊沉积物含有天然物质，在堆积过程中相对不受环境变量的影响。

opts.t: They collect over time in an ordered fashion.
opts.cn: 它们随着时间的推移有序地聚集在一起。

qs.label: C
qs.why:
根据题目提到的”value“定位到第一句：Because they accumulate in an ordered manner that records changes within a lake and its drainage basin, lake sediments are particularly valuable for reconstructing ancient climate conditions. 这句话直接表明湖泊沉积物之所以在重建古代气候条件方面具有特别的价值，是因为它们以有序的方式积累，记录了湖泊及其流域的变化。对应C选项。
A提到的区分自然发生的和人为引起的植被变化，并不是文章提及的湖泊沉积物特别有价值的原因。文章第四句指出使用花粉独立区分这些效应是困难的。
B提到的含有自然物质在累积过程中相对不受环境变量影响，这并不准确。文章第二句说明了这些自然物质（如花粉颗粒、矿物、硅藻和动物微化石）因受环境变量影响而被用来推断过去的条件，而不是说它们在累积过程中不受环境变量的影响。

html: In European lowland heathlands, heather bushes, grasses, and bracken compete with one another for the sandy soil's scarce nutrients, with none acquiring permanent dominance. In Dutch heathlands, however, atmospheric nitrogen pollution produced by intensive animal farming has turned heathlands into grassland, the result of an interaction between nitrogen pollution and heather-eating beetles. Additional nitrogen usually increases growth of both grass and heather, and at first heather usually thrives because the grasses cannot penetrate the canopy of its bushes. Heather beetle population size, like that of many herbivorous insects, varies from year to year. When heather beetles are abundant, their larvae grow particularly well on the nitrogen-enriched heather shoots. Voraciously feeding larvae and adults then defoliate the bushes, tipping the competitive balance between heather and grasses irrevocably.
zh:
①在欧洲低地荒地，石南灌木、草和蕨类植物相互争夺沙质土壤的稀缺养分，但没有一种能获得永久的优势。
②然而，在荷兰的荒地，密集的畜牧业产生的大气氮污染将荒地变成了草原，这是氮污染和食草甲虫相互作用的结果。
③额外的氮通常会增加草和石南花的生长，起初石南花通常会茁壮成长，因为草无法穿透灌木的树冠。
④和许多草食性昆虫一样，石南甲虫的种群大小每年都有所不同。
⑤当石南甲虫数量充足时，它们的幼虫在富含氮的石南芽上生长得特别好。
⑥贪婪进食的幼虫和成虫使得灌木丛落叶，不可逆转地打破了石南花和草之间的竞争平衡。

qs.stem: Which of the followings best describes the function of the highlighted sentence in the author's explanation?
qs.zh: 以下中哪一项最能描述作者解释中加粗句子的功能？

opts.t: It supplies information to explain changes in atmospheric nitrogen pollution.
opts.cn: 它提供了解释大气氮污染变化的信息。

opts.t: It emphasizes the extent to which Dutch heathlands are ecologically fragile environments.
opts.cn: 它强调荷兰荒原是生态脆弱的环境的程度。

opts.t: It provides an example of a factor beyond the control of those seeking to preserve heather bushes.
opts.cn: 它提供了一个跳出那些试图保护石南灌丛的控制范围的因素的例子。

opts.t: It suggests that the presence of intensive animal farming has been unfairly blamed for the demise of Dutch heathlands.
opts.cn: 它暗示了密集养殖业的存在对荷兰荒原的衰落被错误地指责。

opts.t: It explains why there might be a lag between increases in atmospheric nitrogen and damage to heather.
opts.cn: 它解释了为什么大气氮的增加和石南灌丛的损害之间可能存在滞后。

qs.label: E
qs.why:
加粗句子说明了石南甲虫种群数量每年都在变化，这解释了为什么大气氮增加后对石南植物的损害可能会有滞后效应，因为石南甲虫的种群数量并不是每年都一样多，只有当石南甲虫数量较多时，石南植物才会受到严重影响。

其他选项：
It supplies information to explain changes in atmospheric nitrogen pollution.
加粗句子并没有解释大气氮污染的变化。
It emphasizes the extent to which Dutch heathlands are ecologically fragile environments.
加粗句子主要在讲石南甲虫种群的变化，并没有特别强调荷兰荒地的生态脆弱性。
It provides an example of a factor beyond the control of those seeking to preserve heather bushes.
加粗句子的主要功能是解释滞后效应，而不是强调这是一个无法控制的因素。
It suggests that the presence of intensive animal farming has been unfairly blamed for the demise of Dutch heathlands.
加粗句子并没有讨论密集畜牧业是否被不公平地指责，而是解释了石南甲虫种群变化对石南植物的影响。

html: Some studies have shown that red-backed salamanders (RBS) are scarce in areas with acidic soils and that those present in such conditions have smaller-than-average bodies. Explanations have included the possibility that young RBS are adversely affected by acidic soil, that adult RBS can sense and may avoid acidic soil conditions, or that loss of RBS prey populations due to acidic soil could result in reduced RBS populations. Yet researchers found fairly high densities of large- bodied RBS at Lake Claire Watershed, where soil conditions are acidic. One hypothesis is that intraspecific geographical variation in acidity tolerance (i.e., local adaptation to an acidic environment) could exist for RBS. Previous studies showed potential local adaptation of some salamander species to acidity.
zh:
①一些研究表明，红背蝾螈（RBS）在有酸性土壤的地区很少见，而且在这种条件下出现的红背蝾螈的体型比平均体型小。
②对此的解释包括：幼年红背蝾螈可能会受到酸性土壤的不利影响；成年红背蝾螈能够感知酸性土壤并可能会避开酸性土壤；酸性土壤导致红背蝾螈的猎物数量减少，从而导致红背蝾螈数量减少。
③然而，研究人员在LCW发现了相当高密度的大体型 RBS，那里的土壤条件呈酸性。
④一个假设是，RBS 的耐酸性可能存在种内地理差异（即对酸性环境的局部适应）。
⑤以前的研究表明，一些蝾螈物种可能对酸性环境有局部适应性。

qs.stem: The primary purpose of the passage is to
qs.zh: 文章的主要目的是

opts.t: cite evidence that appears to contradict a widely held assumption
opts.cn: 引用似乎与广泛持有的假设相矛盾的证据

opts.t: present contrasting interpretations of a particular research finding
opts.cn: 对某一研究结果提出不同的解释

opts.t: explain how a particular environmental change can produce diverse outcomes
opts.cn: 解释特定的环境变化如何产生不同的结果

opts.t: note an unexpected finding and summarize new possible explanation for it
opts.cn: 指出一项意外发现，并总结可能的新解释

opts.t: identify a correlation and explain why one hypothesis about it is more persuasive than others
opts.cn: 确定一种相关性，并解释为什么关于这种相关性的一种假设比其他假设更有说服力

qs.label: D
qs.why:
文章开头提到了一些关于红背蝾螈（RBS）在酸性土壤中较少见的研究，但随后作者提出了一个意外的发现，即在酸性土壤的Lake Claire Watershed区域发现了大量体型较大的红背蝾螈。
"Yet researchers found fairly high densities of large-bodied RBS at Lake Claire Watershed, where soil conditions are acidic."这个发现与之前的研究结果不一致，作者接着提出了新的假设——可能存在红背蝾螈的地理性对酸性环境的耐受性适应："One hypothesis is that intraspecific geographical variation in acidity tolerance (i.e., local adaptation to an acidic environment) could exist for RBS."

因此，文章的主要目的是提到一个意外的发现，并总结提出了新的解释，对应D选项。

其他选项：
cite evidence that appears to contradict a widely held assumption
文章确实提到了与之前研究结果相反的发现，但作者并没有引用证据来反驳某种广泛持有的假设。相反，文章重点在于解释该发现，并不是为了反驳之前的假设。
present contrasting interpretations of a particular research finding
这个选项不准确。文章提到了一些对红背蝾螈减少的解释，但文章的重点并不在于对单一研究发现的对比解释，而是引出了一个意外的发现，并提出了一个新的假设。
explain how a particular environmental change can produce diverse outcomes
文章并没有讨论特定的环境变化导致的多样化结果，重点是在解释红背蝾螈在酸性土壤中的异常发现。
identify a correlation and explain why one hypothesis about it is more persuasive than others
文章并没有提到任何特定假设比其他假设更具说服力。它仅提出了一个新的可能的解释，即红背蝾螈可能对酸性环境有地理性适应，但没有对不同假设进行详细比较。

qs.stem: Which of the following can be inferred about the studies mentioned in the highlighted portion of the passage?
qs.zh: 关于加粗部分提到的研究，可以推断出以下哪项？

opts.t: They may have undercounted RBS in their study areas due to faulty methodology.
opts.cn: 由于研究方法有误，他们可能对研究地区的 RBS 计算不足。

opts.t: They focused less on adult RBS than on RBS in the early stages of their development.
opts.cn: 他们对成年 RBS 的关注少于对处于发育早期的 RBS 的关注。

opts.t: They found evidence that acidic conditions adversely affect the prey on which RBS depend.
opts.cn: 他们发现有证据表明，酸性环境会对 RBS 赖以生存的猎物造成不利影响。

opts.t: They drew unsubstantiated conclusions about the possible adverse effects of acidic conditions on RBS.
opts.cn: 他们就酸性条件对 RBS 可能产生的不利影响得出了未经证实的结论。

opts.t: They were conducted in areas where the soil conditions were similar to those at Lake Claire Watershed.
opts.cn: 这些研究是在土壤条件与LCW相似的地区进行的。

qs.label: E
qs.why:
“some studies have shown that RBS are scarce in areas with acidic soils …”
“researchers found … RBS at Lake Claire Watershed, where soil conditions are acidic.”
两处都明确说了“酸性土壤（acidic soils）”。可以推出，首句提到的研究是在酸性土壤区域进行的，而Lake Claire也是酸性土壤——土壤条件相似（至少在“酸性”这一关键维度上相同）。选 E选项。

其他选项：
They may have undercounted RBS in their study areas due to faulty methodology.
第一句只是报告了结果“scarce… smaller-than-average bodies”，没提方法问题。

They focused less on adult RBS than on RBS in the early stages of their development.
原文没说这些研究把精力偏向幼体；第二句只是列出可能的解释（幼体受损、成体回避、猎物减少），不是说研究“更少关注成体”。

They found evidence that acidic conditions adversely affect the prey on which RBS depend.
第二句的表述是“Explanations have included the possibility … loss of RBS prey… could result…”，只是可能的解释，并不是首句那些研究“发现了证据”。

They drew unsubstantiated conclusions about the possible adverse effects of acidic conditions on RBS.
第一句说“have shown…”，表述为研究结果；第二句也用“possibility”说明这些只是解释的可能性，并没评价说“无根据”。

html: When studying shrimp feeding from hydrothermal vents at the bottom of the ocean, biologists were surprised that the shrimp's reproductive cycles followed seasonal patterns. Far beyond the reach of sunlight, and with food abundant around the vents all year round, why should such animals reproduce seasonally? The answer might involve their offspring, which in their larval form drift in the currents to colonize new vents. The larvae must feed during their trip, and their springtime release coincides with a peak in algae raining down from surface waters. So far, researchers have found no evidence of seasonal breeding among vent-dwelling species that provide their offspring with yolk to sustain them or among vent-dwelling species found in areas of the ocean with no seasonal algae blooms.
zh:
①当研究生物学家在海洋底部的热涌口观察对虾觅食时，他们惊讶地发现对虾的繁殖周期按照季节性的模式进行。
②它们远离阳光，而且整年喷口周围都有丰富的食物，为什么这些动物要季节性繁殖呢？
③答案可能涉及到它们的后代，它们以幼体的形式在洋流中漂流，然后在新的喷口定居。
④这些幼体必须在旅途中觅食，而它们在春天释放出来的时间正好与从海面水域降落的藻类高峰期相吻合。
⑤到目前为止，研究人员尚未发现任何证据表明，在为后代提供卵黄以维持生命的喷口居住物种中，或在海洋中没有季节性水华的地区发现的喷口居住物种中，存在季节性繁殖。

qs.stem: Which of the following best describes the function of the highlighted sentence?
qs.zh: 以下哪项最佳地描述了加粗句子的功能

opts.t: It casts doubt on the accuracy of earlier observations of seasonal breeding among shrimp species living near hydro-thermal vents.
opts.cn: 它质疑了生活在热液喷口附近的某些虾类物种的季节繁殖早先观测结果的准确性。

opts.t: It undermines the explanation proposed for seasonal breeding among some shrimp species living near hydro-thermal vents.
opts.cn: 它削弱了关于生活在热液喷口附近的某些虾类物种季节繁殖的解释。

opts.t: It suggests that alternative theories are needed to explain seasonal breeding among shrimp species living near hydro-thermal vents.
opts.cn: 它暗示需要采用其他理论来解释生活在热液喷口附近的某些虾类物种的季节繁殖。

opts.t: It describes the survival benefits to shrimp of mating in parts of the ocean where algae blooms rain down abundantly.
opts.cn: 它描述了虾类在海洋藻类大量下落的地区交配的生存益处。

opts.t: It supports the explanation proffered for the seasonal breeding observed among some shrimp species living near hydro-thermal vents.
opts.cn: 它支持关于生活在热液喷口附近的某些虾类物种观察到的季节繁殖的解释。

qs.label: E
qs.why: 加粗句提到研究者在不提供卵黄来支持它们后代或在海洋中没有季节性藻类爆发区域的热液喷口居住种类中未发现季节性繁殖的证据。这支持了前文提出的解释，即某些虾类在春天产卵以便与表层水域中藻类达到高峰时期的“落藻”相吻合，是为了保证其幼苗在漂流过程中有足够的食物。

html: Although the passenger pigeons, now extinct, were abundant in eighteenth- and nineteenth- century America, archaeological studies at twelfth-century Cahokian sites in the present day United States examined household food trash and found that traces of passenger pigeon were quite rare. Given that the sites were close to a huge passenger pigeon roost documented by John James Audubon in the nineteenth century and that Cahokians consumed almost every other animal protein source available, the archaeologists conducting the studies concluded the passenger pigeon population had once been very limited before increasing dramatically in post-Columbian America. Other archaeologists have criticized those conclusions on the grounds that passenger pigeon bones would not be likely to be preserved. But all the archaeological projects found plenty of bird bones and even tiny bones from fish.
zh:
①虽然现已灭绝的鸽子在十八和十九世纪的美国大量出现，但在现今美国的十二世纪C遗址进行的考古研究对家庭食物垃圾进行了检查，发现鸽子的踪迹非常罕见。
②鉴于这些遗址靠近JJA在19 世纪记录的一个巨大的客鸽栖息地，而且C人几乎食用了所有其他动物蛋白质来源，因此进行研究的考古学家得出结论，客鸽的数量曾经非常有限，后来在哥伦布时期之后的美洲急剧增加。
③其他考古学家批评了这些结论，理由是客鸽的骨头不可能保存下来。
④但是，所有的考古项目都发现了大量的鸟类骨骼，甚至还有细小的鱼骨。

qs.stem: Which of the following, if true, would most call into question the reasoning of “the archaeologists conducting the studies”?
qs.zh: 以下哪项如果为真，最能质疑 "进行研究的考古学家 "的推理？

opts.t: Audubon was unable to correctly identify twelfth-century Cahokian sites
opts.cn: A无法正确识别 12 世纪的卡霍基遗址

opts.t: Audubon made his observations before passenger pigeon populations began to decline.
opts.cn: A是在客鸽数量开始减少之前进行观察的。

opts.t: Passenger pigeons would have been attracted to household food trash
opts.cn: 客鸽会被家庭食物垃圾所吸引

opts.t: Archaeologist have found passenger pigeon remains among food waste at eighteenth- century human settlements
opts.cn: 考古学家在 18 世纪人类居住区的食物垃圾中发现了客鸽的残骸

opts.t: Passenger pigeons tended not to roost at the same sites for very many generations
opts.cn: 客鸽往往不会世代栖息在同一地点

qs.label: E
qs.why:
考古学家发现在距今12世纪的Cahokia遗址中，家用食物残渣里几乎没有旅鸽（passenger pigeon）的痕迹。
然而，该遗址在19世纪时（据约翰·詹姆斯·奥杜邦/John James Audubon的记录）靠近一个非常庞大的旅鸽栖息地。
由此，这些考古学家推断旅鸽在前哥伦布时期（pre-Columbian America）数量非常有限，后在美洲殖民时期才大量繁衍。
考古学家的关键前提是：“Given that the sites were close to a huge passenger pigeon roost documented by John James Audubon in the nineteenth century...”
他们假设19世纪这个巨大的栖息地在12世纪时也应当存在或大致相同（否则Cahokia人找不到）。所以，12世纪食物残渣中没发现旅鸽，就推断“当时旅鸽数量极少”。

如果E选项为真，说明旅鸽的栖息地经常变化，往往不会在同一地点持续很多代。那么奥杜邦在19世纪发现的这个大栖息地，不代表12世纪也在同一处。如果12世纪这群旅鸽可能根本不在这里活动，食物残渣中没有旅鸽就不足为奇；这并不能证明旅鸽整体种群数量少，只能说明它们当时没在这儿。如果这样，就会直接动摇考古学家“12世纪旅鸽数量极少”的推断。

qs.stem: The author of the passage mentions “tiny bones from fish” primarily in order to
qs.zh: 这段文字的作者提到 "鱼的细小骨头"，主要是为了

opts.t: explain why traces of passenger pigeon are rare at Cahokian sites
opts.cn: 解释为什么在C遗址中很少发现客鸽的踪迹

opts.t: support a claim about the wide variety of animal proteins in the Cahokian diet
opts.cn: 支持关于C人饮食中动物蛋白种类繁多的说法

opts.t: provide evidence that confirms a theory about the extinction of the passenger pigeon
opts.cn: 提供证据证实客鸽灭绝的理论

opts.t: cast doubt on the conclusion reached by the archaeologists who conducted the studies discussed in the passage
opts.cn: 对文中讨论的考古学家得出的结论表示怀疑

opts.t: counter an objection to an interpretation of the data obtained from Cahokian sites
opts.cn: 反驳对从C遗址获得的数据的解释提出的反对意见

qs.label: E
qs.why:
第三句说：Other archaeologists have criticized those conclusions on the grounds that passenger pigeon bones would not be likely to be preserved. 其他考古学家对第二句的结论提出批评，认为乘客鸽的骨头不太可能被保存下来。
但是，所有的考古项目都发现了大量的鸟骨和甚至是鱼的微小骨头。这表明，如果连鱼的微小骨头都能被保存下来，那么对第三句的批评是不合理的，因为这说明保存条件是允许骨头保存的，包括可能的乘客鸽骨头。
因此，提及鱼的微小骨头是为了反驳关于骨头保存可能性的批评，对应E选项。

其他选项：
explain why traces of passenger pigeon are rare at Cahokian sites
提到“tiny bones from fish”并不是在解释稀少原因，而是在否定“不易保存”这个稀少原因。

support a claim about the wide variety of animal proteins in the Cahokian diet
饮食多样性已有前文支撑：“Cahokians consumed almost every other animal protein source available.” 提到“tiny bones from fish”是为了证明保存条件足够好。

provide evidence that confirms a theory about the extinction of the passenger pigeon
文章没有讨论信鸽为何灭绝；“now extinct”只是背景。没有任何“灭绝理论”的提出与验证。

cast doubt on the conclusion reached by the archaeologists who conducted the studies discussed in the passage
作者是在维护原团队的结论（“the passenger pigeon population had once been very limited…”），并反驳他人的保存性质疑。

html:
This photographer's recent portraits make no effort to show the subject within a social setting or among the objects that express his or her way of life. The signature white background against which little more than the subject's head is shown is meant, one supposes, to suggest the metaphor of a soul stripped bare. By eliminating superficial means of signalling psychology and status, the photographer, some critics assert, heroically challenges himself to find expressive means to reveal his subject’s truth.

Arguably, however, the photographer's fierce scrutiny—a kind of visual interrogation—in the portraits tells us little about the essence of their subjects. In these images the subjects often seem stripped of dignity and worth so that the portraits appear to be merely transcriptions of an aggressiveness, a cutting down to size, on the photographer's part. It would be greatly to his artistic benefit if he were to leave the studio behind and return to the real world where some of his best portraits were made in the 1950s and 1960s.
zh:
①这位摄影师最近拍摄的肖像作品，没有刻意去表现被摄者在社会环境中或在表达其生活方式的物品中的形象。
②其标志性的白色背景只露出被摄者的头部，人们猜测这是为了暗示灵魂被剥离的隐喻。
③一些评论家断言，摄影师通过摒弃表面的心理和地位表达方式，勇于挑战自我，寻找表现手法来揭示拍摄对象的真实面貌。

④然而，可以说，摄影师在肖像画中的严格审视--一种视觉审问--并没有告诉我们被摄者的本质。
⑤在这些照片中，人物往往被剥夺了尊严和价值，使得这些肖像看起来仅仅是对某种攻击性的记录——摄影师通过这种方式将人物的形象“缩小”到了一个更平凡、更可控制的尺度。
⑥如果摄影师离开工作室，回到现实世界——在那里他在1950年代和1960年代拍摄了一些最好的肖像——这将对他的艺术创作大有裨益。

qs.stem: Given the point of view expressed in the passage, the author would be most likely to agree with which of the following statements about photographic portraiture?
qs.zh: 鉴于文中所表达的观点，作者最有可能同意以下哪种关于肖像摄影的说法？

opts.t: It can reveal the attitude of the photographer as well as that of the subject.
opts.cn: 肖像摄影既能揭示摄影师的态度，也能揭示拍摄对象的态度。

opts.t: It tends to mask a subject's psychology and status by focusing on the social setting and objects that are related to that person.
opts.h: It tends to mask a subject's psychology and status by focusing on the social setting and objects that are related to that person.
opts.cn: 肖像摄影往往会掩盖被摄者的心理和地位，而把重点放在与被摄者有关的社会环境和物品上。

opts.t: It is most revealing when the subject is unaware that a photograph is being taken.
opts.cn: 当被摄者不知道照片正在拍摄时，最能体现其特点。

opts.t: It is resistant to attempts on the part of the photographer to strip a subject of dignity and worth.
opts.cn: 它能抵制摄影师试图剥夺被摄者尊严和价值的企图。

opts.t: It reached a height of excellence in the 1950s and 1960s that has not been matched in more recent times.
opts.cn: 它在二十世纪五六十年代达到了卓越的顶峰，近代以来无人能及。

qs.label: A
qs.why:
第二段前两句提到：“Arguably, however, the photographer's fierce scrutiny-a kind of visual interrogation-in the portraits tells us little about the essence of their subjects. In these images the subjects often seem stripped of dignity and worth so that the portraits appear to be merely transcriptions of an aggressiveness.” 这表明摄影师的态度（强烈审视、侵略性）和拍摄方法直接影响了照片的表达和内容。根据”tells us little about the essence of their subjects“推出作者认为摄影肖像能揭示拍摄对象的态度，根据”an aggressiveness“推出作者认为摄影肖像也能揭示揭示摄影师的态度。对应A选项。

其他选项：
It tends to mask a subject's psychology and status by focusing on the social setting and objects that are related to that person.
作者概述这位摄影师是通过去掉“superficial means of signalling psychology and status”来拍摄；可见社会情境与物件本来就是用来“signal（显露）”心理与地位的，而不是“mask（遮蔽）”。

It is most revealing when the subject is unaware that a photograph is being taken.
文中没提“不知情拍摄”；作者批评的是审讯式的“fierce scrutiny”与棚拍白底，并没论证“抓拍/不知情”更好。

It is resistant to attempts on the part of the photographer to strip a subject of dignity and worth.
作者明确说主体“seem stripped of dignity and worth”。

It reached a height of excellence in the 1950s and 1960s that has not been matched in more recent times.
文中只说这位摄影师“some of his best portraits were made in the 1950s and 1960s”，是针对他个人的作品评价，并没下结论说整个肖像摄影领域的巅峰在那个年代且没被超越。

html: New Zealand's lesser short-tailed bat, Mystacina tuberculata, is one of only two bat species to use a true walking gait when maneuvering on the ground. It has been assumed that the specialized terrestrial habits of mystacinids evolved in New Zealand following their isolation there. Absence of native terrestrial mammalian predators in New Zealand has been hypothesized to have facilitated evolution of terrestriality. However, although it is likely that terrestrial foraging by extant Mystacina tuberculata makes it vulnerable to introduced mammaliar predators, there is as yet limited available data on the actual risk of terrestriality. Indeed, Lloyd argues that although some individuals may be caught on the ground, generally they would not be easy prey: they are cryptic, fast-moving, with acute hearing and olfaction and can quickly take flight.
zh:
①新西兰的小短尾蝙蝠Mt是仅有的两种在地面活动时使用真正步行步态的蝙蝠之一。
②据推测，新西兰的短尾蝙蝠是在与世隔绝后才进化出专门的陆地生活习性的。
③新西兰本土没有陆生哺乳动物捕食者，这被假定为促进了陆生习性的进化。
④然而，尽管现存的Mt很可能在陆地上觅食，因此很容易受到引入的哺乳动物捕食者的攻击，但目前有关其陆栖风险的实际数据还很有限。
⑤事实上，L认为，尽管有些个体可能会在地面上被捕获，但一般来说，它们不会是容易捕获的猎物：它们隐蔽、行动迅速、听觉和嗅觉灵敏，并能迅速飞行。

qs.stem: The passage is primarily concerned with
qs.zh: 文章主要涉及

opts.t: outlining certain difficulties associated with the study of a particular species
opts.cn: 概述与特定物种研究相关的某些困难

opts.t: suggesting that the development of a phenomenon was not predicated upon a particular condition
opts.cn: 表明某种现象的发展并不是以某种特定条件为前提的

opts.t: pointing out that a particular event is rarely known to occur
opts.cn: 指出某一事件很少发生

opts.t: detailing evidence that refutes a commonly held notion
opts.cn: 详细说明反驳普遍观点的证据

opts.t: evaluating rival interpretations of a phenomenon
opts.cn: 评估对某一现象的对立解释

qs.label: B
qs.why:
原文中提到了一种假设："Absence of native terrestrial mammalian predators in New Zealand has been hypothesized to have facilitated evolution of terrestriality."
人们假设新西兰缺少地面哺乳动物捕食者，促进了蝙蝠的地面活动习性（terrestriality）的进化。

但后文却说："there is as yet limited available data on the actual risk of terrestriality."
“Indeed, Lloyd argues that although some individuals may be caught on the ground, generally they would not be easy prey…”
也就是说，作者引用了Lloyd的观点，说明就算蝙蝠在地面活动，实际上也不容易被捕食。因此，这种进化行为（地面行走）并不一定是由于没有捕食者才出现的。

这对应了B选项的意思：这种行为的出现（terrestriality）并不是建立在（predicated upon）“没有捕食者”这一条件上的。

其他选项：
outlining certain difficulties associated with the study of a particular species
文中并没有讲“研究这个蝙蝠”有多难，而是在讨论这个蝙蝠的行为是不是因为没有捕食者才进化出来的。

pointing out that a particular event is rarely known to occur
文章不是在讨论某个“事件很少发生”，而是在讨论“地面行走”是否是因为缺少捕食者才进化出来的。

detailing evidence that refutes a commonly held notion
作者没有给出详细证据，只是说“there is limited data”，然后引用了Lloyd的观点。因此并不是“detailing evidence”。

evaluating rival interpretations of a phenomenon
虽然提到了“主流观点”和Lloyd的观点，但并没有进行“评估”（evaluate），只是说明Lloyd的观点存在。

qs.stem: Which of the following can be inferred from the passage about Mystacina tuberculata
qs.zh: 从这段关于Mt的文字中，可以推断出以下哪项内容

opts.t: It derives benefits from ground foraging that outweigh the risks of predation.
opts.cn: 它从地面觅食中获得的益处大于被捕食的风险。

opts.t: Its flying ability is in some respects diminished in comparison with most other bat species.
opts.cn: 与大多数其他蝙蝠物种相比，它的飞行能力在某些方面有所减弱。

opts.t: Its isolation in New Zealand has led to a misunderstanding regarding its abilities.
opts.cn: 由于它在新西兰与世隔绝，人们对它的能力产生了误解。

opts.t: It has developed keener hearing than most other bat species.
opts.cn: 它的听觉比其他大多数蝙蝠物种灵敏。

opts.t: It is not subject to predation by other bat species.
opts.cn: 它不会受到其他蝙蝠物种的捕食。

qs.label: C
qs.why:
文段先给出基于隔离环境的主流假设：“It has been assumed that the specialized terrestrial habits of mystacinids evolved in New Zealand following their isolation there.”
又对“地面活动=易受捕食”这一由假设衍生的看法提出质疑：
“there is as yet limited available data on the actual risk of terrestriality.”
“Lloyd argues that … generally they would not be easy prey: they are cryptic, fast-moving … and can quickly take flight.”
由“隔离→演化出步行→因此在地面容易被捕”这一链条，文中用“证据有限+不易被捕”去修正/反驳，可推知：对其“能力”（地面逃生、反捕食能力）的认识因隔离背景而被误导。选C选项。

其他选项：
It derives benefits from ground foraging that outweigh the risks of predation.
文中没有谈“收益>风险”。只说“证据有限/不确定”(“there is as yet limited available data on the actual risk of terrestriality.”)，不能据此推出“收益超过风险”。

Its flying ability is in some respects diminished in comparison with most other bat species.
文中没做“与多数蝙蝠”的比较，文本反而显示飞行反应很快(“can quickly take flight.”)

It has developed keener hearing than most other bat species.
文中只说其具备“灵敏听觉嗅觉”，没有与“多数蝙蝠”比较。

It is not subject to predation by other bat species.
文中没提到“其他蝙蝠捕食”，也没说“不会被其捕食”。反而承认地面上“可能被捕”（“although some individuals may be caught on the ground”）

html: The most common type of fishing gear found in Chumash archaeological sites in present-day coastal California is the single-piece curved fishhook made from bone or shell. The best archaeological evidence that the Chumash also used nets are grooved and notched stones. Such stones could have weighted nets and have been found at a number of late period sites, although ethnographic sources suggest that these apparent sinkers may have been attached to a line for a fishhook. At one Chumash site, the 7,655 identified otoliths (ear bones) from white croaker fish were close to the same size. Archaeologists have proposed that the uniformity of the otoliths indicates that the croakers were captured with gill nets, which would trap fish within a narrow size range.
zh:
①在当今加利福尼亚海岸的C考古遗址中发现的最常见的渔具类型是由骨头或贝壳制成的单件弯曲鱼钩。
②C人也使用网的最佳考古证据是有凹槽和缺口的石头。
③这种石头可能被用来加重鱼网，而且在许多晚期遗址上已经发现了这种石头，尽管民族学的资料表明，这些看似的沉石可能曾经被用来作为钓鱼钩的系绳之用。
④在C的一个遗址上，经过鉴定的7,655个O的耳石（耳骨）大小非常接近。
⑤考古学家提出，这些耳骨的一致性表明这些鱼是用刺网捕获的，这种网可以在一个较窄的大小范围内捕获鱼类。

qs.stem: From the passage, it can be inferred that items found at Chumash archaeological sites did NOT include
qs.zh: 从文章可以推断，在考古遗址发现的物品不包括

opts.t: multipiece fishhooks
opts.cn: 多片鱼钩

opts.t: gill nets
opts.cn: 刺网

opts.t: fish remains other than otoliths
opts.cn: O以外的鱼类遗骸

opts.t: remains of boats
opts.cn: 船只残骸

opts.t: weights for fishing lines
opts.cn: 钓鱼线的配重

qs.label: B
qs.why:
根据第二句"The best archaeological evidence that the Chumash also used nets are grooved and notched stones."既然nets的使用是被间接推出的, 说明并没有在考古遗址直接发现nets。
其他物品在文中没有提到过, 所以无法得知它们有没有在考古遗址被发现（可能有发现，可能没有发现）。
注意：
文中没有说 ≠ 没有
文中没有说 = 未知信息 = 可能有，可能没有

html: Among many historians a belief persists that Cotton Mather’s biographies of some of the settlers of the Massachusetts Bay Colony (published 1702) are exercises in hagiography, endowing their subjects with saintly piety at the expense of historical accuracy. Yet modern studies have profited both from the breadth of information that Mather provides in, for example, his discussions of colonial medicine and from his critical observations of such leading figures as Governor John Winthrop.
