opts.cn: 提供证据，证明在18世纪下半叶，私人赞助渐渐被国家赞助所取代

qs.label: A B
qs.why:
作者先说资助“would survive, in attenuated form, for another 50”，紧接着给出实例——“Indeed, Johnson was in 1762 awarded a pension by the Crown—a subtle form of sponsorship, tantamount to state patronage.” 1762 属于十八世纪下半叶，这正是“资助仍存”的具体例子。A选项正确。

约翰逊1755年写信拒斥赞助，但“in 1762 [he] was… awarded a pension by the Crown—a subtle form of sponsorship, tantamount to state patronage.” 说明在写信之后，资助（以国家养老金的形式）仍在支持他。B选项正确。

其他选项：
provide evidence for a general trend in the later half of the eighteenth century of private patronage’s being replaced by state sponsorship
文章并没提私人赞助被国家赞助取代的总体趋势。虽然提到了 J 获得国家养老金，但这只是个别例子，文章没有说明这是一个普遍现象。

html: Harriet Monroe, who founded Poetry: A Magazine of Verse in 1912, argued that the more heterogeneous and sprawling the modern world became, the more poetry needed “an entrenched place, a voice of power.” But this goal could only be realized if poets were valued in ways that encouraged them to participate in the world and made writing verse economically viable. Monroe argued that poets needed sites of institutional opportunity like those that had been developed for visual artists, architects, and musicians. She believed that the hand-wringing anticapitalism dominating genteel literary culture—particularly the idea that poetry ought to be removed from “sordid” pecuniary considerations—brought no economic and only illusory aesthetic benefits, instead severing poets from meaningful participation in the modern world.
zh:
①HM 于1912年创立了《诗歌：一本文学诗刊》，她认为，现代世界越是变得多样化且无序，诗歌就越需要“一个稳固的地位，一种有力的声音。”
②但是，要实现这一目标，就必须重视诗人，鼓励他们参与世界，并使诗歌写作具有经济可行性。
③M 认为，诗人需要像那些为视觉艺术家、建筑师和音乐家开发的机构一样的机会场所。
④她认为，主导高雅文学文化的手忙脚乱的反资本主义--尤其是认为诗歌应该脱离 “肮脏的 ”金钱考量--并没有带来经济上的好处，只有虚幻的美学好处，反而切断了诗人对现代世界有意义的参与。

qs.stem: The author mentions “visual artists, architects and musicians” primarily to
qs.zh: 作者提到 “视觉艺术家、建筑师和音乐家”，主要是为了

opts.t: note a challenge that Monroe faced when attempting to implement her ideas
opts.cn: 指出 M 在试图实施其理念时所面临的挑战

opts.t: highlight what Monroe regarded as a contrast between the economic needs of poets and those of other artists
opts.cn: 强调 M 认为诗人的经济需求与其他艺术家的经济需求之间的反差

opts.t: explain Monroe’ s ideas about measures that would advance poetry
opts.cn: 解释 M 关于促进诗歌发展的措施的想法

opts.t: acknowledge that anticapitalism had not had undesirable consequences for all art forms
opts.cn: 承认反资本主义并未给所有艺术形式带来不良后果

opts.t: illustrate the point that some art forms are inherently more economically viable than others
opts.cn: 说明某些艺术形式在本质上比其他艺术形式更具经济可行性的观点

qs.label: C
qs.why:
定位到加粗所在句： “Monroe argued that poets needed sites of institutional opportunity like those that had been developed for visual artists, architects, and musicians”，这表明她认为诗人应该有类似于视觉艺术家、建筑师和音乐家那样的机会，以此来促进诗歌的发展。选C选项。

其他选项：
"note a challenge that Monroe faced when attempting to implement her ideas"
文章并没有提到 M 在实施这些想法时面临的具体挑战。
"highlight what Monroe regarded as a contrast between the economic needs of poets and those of other artists"
M 并没有对诗人和其他艺术家的经济需求进行对比，而是提出了诗人需要类似于其他艺术家的机会。
"acknowledge that anticapitalism had not had undesirable consequences for all art forms"
虽然 M 批评了反资本主义对诗歌的影响，但没有提到它对所有艺术形式的影响。
"illustrate the point that some art forms are inherently more economically viable than others"
文章并没有讨论某些艺术形式在经济上是否更可行。

qs.stem: The passage suggests that Monroe believed that finding “an entrenched place, a voice of power for poetry” would rely on which of the following?
qs.zh: 文章暗示，M 认为，要找到 “一个根深蒂固的地方，为诗歌发出有力的声音”，需要依靠以下哪项？

opts.t: Providing poets with a refuge from the sprawling modern world
opts.cn: 为诗人提供一个避风港，使他们远离无边无际的现代世界

opts.t: Ensuring that poetry as an art could remain free of economic considerations
opts.cn: 确保诗歌作为一门艺术不受经济因素的影响

opts.t: Creating institutional opportunities for poets to make their work economically viable
opts.cn: 为诗人创造机构机会，使他们的作品在经济上可行

qs.label: C
qs.why:
原文说要让诗歌获得“an entrenched place, a voice of power”，前提是“poets were valued in ways that encouraged them to participate in the world and made writing verse economically viable”，并且她主张“poets needed sites of institutional opportunity like those… for visual artists, architects, and musicians。”
所以，依赖的是为诗人创造制度性机会、使他们的创作具有经济可行性，对应 C选项。

其他选项：
Providing poets with a refuge from the sprawling modern world
Monroe 强调让诗人“participate in the world”，不是把他们“隔离/庇护”起来。

Ensuring that poetry as an art could remain free of economic considerations
她明确反对把诗歌从金钱考量中抽离：“the idea that poetry ought to be removed from ‘sordid’ pecuniary considerations—brought no economic and only illusory aesthetic benefits, instead severing poets from meaningful participation in the modern world。”

html:
This passage is adapted from material published in 2005.

The intense self-awareness in the soliloquies of Shakespeare’s Hamlet (1599) is a breakthrough that was given tremendous impetus by the playwright’s interest in a new literary form, the essay. Although Montaigne, the form’s originator, published his first volumes of personal essays in France in 1580, English writers such as Shakespeare did not discover Montaigne until the late 1590s. Shakespeare could easily have turned to the essay earlier in his career—his French was good enough to read Montaigne in the original — but he didn’t. Only at the end of the century, a cultural moment marked by a deepening interest in how subjective experience could be expressed, did Montaigne begin to speak to Shakespeare and other English writers with great immediacy.
zh:
①莎士比亚的《哈姆雷特》（1599 年）独白中强烈的自我意识是一次突破，剧作家对散文这种新的文学形式的兴趣极大地推动了这一突破。
②虽然这种文学形式的鼻祖M早在 1580 年就在法国出版了他的第一批个人随笔集，但莎士比亚等英国作家直到 15 世纪 90 年代末才发现M。
③莎士比亚本可以在其创作生涯的早期转向随笔--他的法语好到足以阅读M的原文--但他没有。
④直到世纪末，人们对如何表达主观经验的兴趣日益浓厚，M才开始与莎士比亚和其他英国作家直接对话。

qs.stem: In the passage, the function played by the highlighted portion is to
qs.zh: 在这篇文章中，加粗部分的作用在于

opts.t: support the contention that Montaigne influenced Shakespeare’s early writings
opts.cn: 支持M影响了莎士比亚早期创作的论点

opts.t: emphasize the extent to which writers of Shakespeare’s time borrowed ideas and plotlines from one another
opts.cn: 强调莎士比亚时代的作家相互借鉴思想和情节的程度

opts.t: argue that Shakespeare’s interest in Montaigne was shaped by the prevailing cultural concerns of his time
opts.cn: 论证莎士比亚对M的兴趣是由他所处时代的主流文化所决定的

opts.t: introduce a discussion of the factors that discouraged most English writers from reading French works in the origin language
opts.cn: 讨论阻碍大多数英国作家阅读法语原版作品的因素

opts.t: point out that Shakespeare’s education was superior to that of most other English playwrights of his time
opts.cn: 指出莎士比亚所受的教育优于同时代的其他大多数英国剧作家

qs.label: C
qs.why:
文章主要讨论了莎士比亚对M的兴趣是在世纪末的文化背景下产生的，而这一文化背景标志着对主观经验表达的兴趣加深。
加粗部分（“莎士比亚完全可以在职业生涯早期就转向散文——他的法语足够好，可以读原版蒙田的作品”）旨在说明莎士比亚有能力更早地接触M，但他没有这样做，这支持了主要论点，即莎士比亚对M的兴趣是由当时的文化关切所塑造的，而不是个人能力的限制，对应C选项。

其他选项：
support the contention that Montaigne influenced Shakespeare’s early writings
文中并没有说M影响了莎士比亚的早期作品，相反，是在世纪末莎士比亚才开始受到M的影响。
emphasize the extent to which writers of Shakespeare’s time borrowed ideas and plotlines from one another
文中没有提到莎士比亚时代的作家们互相借鉴想法和情节线。
introduce a discussion of the factors that discouraged most English writers from reading French works in the original language
文中中并没有讨论是什么因素阻止了英国作家阅读法语原著。
point out that Shakespeare’s education was superior to that of most other English playwrights of his time
文中没有比较莎士比亚和其他剧作家的教育水平。

qs.stem: According to the passage, interest in the essay in England was spurred during the late 1590s by
qs.zh: 根据这段文字，15 世纪 90 年代末，英国人对随笔的兴趣受到以下因素的刺激

opts.t: an increasing attention to and knowledge of French language and culture
opts.cn: 对法语和法国文化的关注和了解不断增加

opts.t: a wider interest in experimenting with new literary forms
opts.cn: 对尝试新的文学形式产生了更广泛的兴趣

opts.t: the culture’s growing fascination with giving voice to the intricacies of personal experience
opts.cn: 文化对表达个人经历的复杂性日益着迷

qs.label: C
qs.why:
文章最后一句明确提到，“Only at the end of the century, a cultural moment marked by a deepening interest in how subjective experience could be expressed, did Montaigne begin to speak to Shakespeare and other English writers with great immediacy.” 这表明正是对个人经历复杂性表达的日益浓厚的兴趣促进了文学形式——随笔的关注。

其他选项：
an increasing attention to and knowledge of French language and culture
文章明确说 “his French was good enough to read Montaigne in the original—but he didn’t.”
莎士比亚早就有足够的法语水平可以读蒙田，但并没有因此更早转向随笔；所以并不是“法语能力/法国文化了解提升”在晚1590年代刺激了英国对随笔体的兴趣。

a wider interest in experimenting with new literary forms
第一句出现 “interest in a new literary form, the essay”，但这是说这种兴趣推动了《哈姆雷特》独白的突破，不是说明为何英国在晚1590年代才对随笔体产生兴趣。
真正原因是文化对“如何表达主观经验”的兴趣加深，而不是“泛化的文体实验热”。
“a cultural moment marked by a deepening interest in how subjective experience could be expressed”——强调的是“主观经验的表达”，不是“尝试新文类”的广义风潮。

html: There have been numerous well-documented extinctions of indigenous species caused by the introduction of nonindigenous predators and pathogens. However, surprisingly few extinctions of indigenous species can be attributed to competition from introduced species. For example, during the past 400 years, 4,000 plant species have been introduced into North America, and these nonindigenous plants currently account for nearly 20 percent of North America’s plant species. Yet no evidence exists that any indigenous North American plant species became extinct as a result of competition from introduced plant species. The scarcity of documented extinctions caused by competition from new species could mean that such extinctions take longer to occur than scientists initially believed or, alternatively, that extinctions are rarely caused by competition from nonindigenous species.
zh:
①由于引入非本地捕食者和病原体，导致本地物种灭绝的记录不胜枚举。
②然而，能够归咎于外来物种竞争的本土物种灭绝却少得令人吃惊。
③例如，在过去的 400 年中，有 4000 种植物被引入北美，这些非本土植物目前占北美植物物种的近 20%。
④然而，没有证据表明任何北美本土植物物种因引入植物物种的竞争而灭绝。
⑤由于新物种的竞争而导致灭绝的记录很少，这可能意味着这种灭绝发生的时间比科学家最初认为的要长，或者说，非本地物种的竞争很少导致灭绝。

qs.stem: The author introduces statistics about North America’s nonindigenous plant species primarily in order to
qs.zh: 作者介绍北美非本土植物物种的统计数据主要是为了

opts.t: undermine a proposed explanation for the absence of any evidence for the occurrence of a particular phenomenon.
opts.cn: 削弱对某一现象的发生缺乏任何证据的解释。

opts.t: contrast the effect of introduced plant species in North America with the effect that introduced animal species have had.
opts.cn: 将北美引进植物物种的影响与引进动物物种的影响进行对比。

opts.t: suggest that North America’s indigenous plants are a domain in which there has been ample scope for a particular effect to have occurred.
opts.cn: 提出北美洲本土植物是一个有足够空间产生特定影响的领域。

opts.t: emphasize how much the ecology of North America has been affected over the past 400 years by the introduction of nonindigenous species
opts.cn: 强调在过去 400 年中，非本土物种的引入对北美生态的影响有多大

opts.t: substantiate a claim about the overall effect that the introduction of nonindigenous species tends to have on indigenous populations.
opts.cn: 支持一个关于引入非本土物种往往对本土种群产生的总体影响的说法

qs.label: C
qs.why:
找到“statistics about North America’s nonindigenous plant species”：“during the past 400 years, 4,000 plant species have been introduced into North America, and these nonindigenous plants currently account for nearly 20 percent of North America’s plant species（在过去的400年里，4000种植物被引入北美，这些外来植物目前占北美植物种类的近20%）。”这个统计数据说明，北美本土植物有足够的机会受到外来植物竞争的影响，对应C选项。
第三句首先用具体的数字展示北美本土植物有足够的机会受到外来植物竞争的影响，第四句转折yet后说“没有证据表明任何北美本土植物物种因引入植物物种的竞争而灭绝”。第三句和第四句一起展开解释了第二句“能够归咎于外来物种竞争的本土物种灭绝却少得令人吃惊”。
即，作者通过引入统计数据说明“北美本土植物有足够的机会受到外来植物竞争的影响”，进一步说明“能够归咎于外来物种竞争的本土物种灭绝少得令人吃惊”。

其他选项：
undermine a proposed explanation for the absence of any evidence for the occurrence of a particular phenomenon
作者并没“推翻”某个已提出的解释；相反，结尾还提出两个可能解释（灭绝更慢/很少由竞争造成）。

contrast the effect of introduced plant species in North America with the effect that introduced animal species have had
文章并没有进行植物种类和动物种类之间影响的比较。

emphasize how much the ecology of North America has been affected over the past 400 years by the introduction of nonindigenous species
不是强调生态变动有多大，而是强调“机会充足但未见灭绝”。

substantiate a claim about the overall effect that the introduction of nonindigenous species tends to have on indigenous populations
没有下“总体效应”的实证结论，只讨论竞争致灭绝这个特定现象的证据缺乏。

qs.stem: The passage is concerned primarily with
qs.zh: 这段话主要涉及

opts.t: Pointing out that a particular type of species extinction is rarely known to occur
opts.cn: 指出一种特定类型的物种灭绝很少发生

opts.t: Proposing a possible explanation for conflicting data about a particular type of species extinction
opts.cn: 对某类物种灭绝的矛盾数据提出可能的解释

opts.t: Resolving a debate about the frequency of a particular type of species extinction
opts.cn: 解决关于某类物种灭绝频率的争论

opts.t: Comparing two theories regarding possible causes of a particular type of species extinction
opts.cn: 比较关于某类物种灭绝可能原因的两种理论

opts.t: Refuting a proposed explanation for the increasingly rare occurrence of a particular type of species extinction
opts.cn: 反驳对某一特定类型物种灭绝日益罕见所提出的解释

qs.label: A
qs.why:
作者先给出一个令人惊讶的事实：北美过去400年引入了4000种植物，占北美植物种类的近20%，但没有任何证据表明由它们竞争导致了本地植物灭绝。最后一段指出，这种缺乏文献记载的现象可能有两种解释：要么是灭绝需要更长时间才会发生（所以目前没看见），要么就是竞争并不常造成灭绝。
整篇文章的主轴是“指出这类灭绝（由竞争导致）很少被记录到/几乎没发现”，然后才顺带提出两种可能解释。


其他选项：
Proposing a possible explanation for conflicting data about a particular type of species extinction
文中并没有出现“数据相互冲突” (conflicting data) ，只是指出了一个令人惊讶的现象（introductions 多，但由竞争导致的灭绝少），并给出了两种可能原因，这不是解释“互相矛盾”或“冲突”的数据。

Resolving a debate about the frequency of a particular type of species extinction
原文没有真正“解决”任何争论，只是提出了两种推测/可能性，并没得出最终的解决方案。

Comparing two theories regarding possible causes of a particular type of species extinction
文中提出了两个可能原因（时间不够长或确实很少发生），但这两个可能原因不是对“灭绝原因本身”的两大对立理论，文章也没有系统地进行比较分析，更没有强调“灭绝机制”到底是哪种理论更对。

Refuting a proposed explanation for the increasingly rare occurrence of a particular type of species extinction
文章并没有在“驳斥”任何说法，而是提出了两种可能解释，没有立场上的批判或反驳。

html: Academics have been reconsidering the meaning of “wilderness” and its usefulness to conservation strategies. The idea of pristine wilderness is historically inaccurate, argue scholars of Native American history, who have demonstrated that Native Americans shaped their environments with their agricultural practices and residential patterns. Other scholars argue that wilderness is simply a cultural construct created in opposition to modern society, not a real place untouched by humans. Scientists in turn, have argued that the goal of wilderness preservation is based on a model in which ecosystems progress toward a stable equilibrium state, a model replaced in the 1970s with one stressing constant change. These insights complicate wilderness management which critics charge aims to preserve a supposedly stable environment that existed prior to human disturbance.
zh:
①学术界一直在重新考虑“荒野”的含义及其对保护策略的有用性。
②美洲原住民历史学者认为，原始荒野的概念在历史上是不准确的，他们已经证明，美洲原住民的农业实践和居住模式塑造了他们的环境。
③其他学者认为，荒野只是一种与现代社会对立的文化建构，而不是一个未被人类触及的真实地方。
④反过来，科学家们认为，荒野保护的目标是基于一个生态系统向稳定平衡状态发展的模型，该模型在20世纪70年代被一个强调不断变化的模型所取代。
⑤这些见解使荒野管理复杂化，批评者指责荒野管理旨在保护一个在人类干扰之前就存在的所谓稳定的环境。

qs.stem: Which of the following statements best describes the function of the highlighted sentence?
qs.zh: 以下哪项陈述最能描述突出显示的句子的功能？

opts.t: It undermines a claim made in the previous sentence.
opts.cn: 它削弱了前一句中的说法。

opts.t: It introduces a perspective that the author disputes.
opts.cn: 它介绍了一个作者提出异议的观点。

opts.t: It elaborates on a claim made earlier in the passage.
opts.cn: 它详细阐述了前文提出的论断。

opts.t: It introduces a traditional point of view.
opts.cn: 它介绍了一种传统观点。

opts.t: It describes a recent scholarly controversy.
opts.cn: 它描述了最近的一场学术争论。

qs.label: C
qs.why:
首句总领：“Academics have been reconsidering the meaning of ‘wilderness’ and its usefulness to conservation strategies.” 接下来各句依次给出不同学术群体的具体观点来“展开/举例说明”这个“重新审视”。加粗句子正是其中一个具体观点，所以它的功能是“对前文总述加以展开”，对应C选项。

其他选项：
It undermines a claim made in the previous sentence.
前一句：“The idea of pristine wilderness is historically inaccurate, argue scholars of Native American history …”
标注句：“Other scholars argue that wilderness is simply a cultural construct … not a real place untouched by humans.”
两句并非相互削弱，而是同向质疑“原始/未受人类影响的荒野”观念：上句从历史事实（原住民改造环境）破“原始”，本句从概念层面（文化建构、反现代社会的对立物）破“真实之地”。因此不是削弱，而是并列补充。

It introduces a perspective that the author disputes.
通篇作者保持转述与综述语气：“argue…,” “have argued…,” “These insights complicate …”，没有任何作者反驳/质疑的标记语。

It introduces a traditional point of view.
传统观点是被加粗句所否定的：“a real place untouched by humans.” 加粗句将“wilderness”界定为文化建构而非“传统的自然本体”，所以不是传统观点。

It describes a recent scholarly controversy.
加粗句只呈现一方观点：“Other scholars argue …”，并没呈现对立双方在该句内的交锋，也没有“recent”时间线索。

html: The decline of the heath hen began when the first Europeans arrived on the East Coast of North America. Before European settlement, Native Americans used fire to maintain a mosaic of forests, shrublands, agricultural fields, and grasslands. After European diseases decimated Native American populations, the formerly open habitats of the Northeast became largely forested, resulting in major changes to bird communities and probably reducing suitable heath hen habitat. Although the clearing of forests by European settlers probably once again increased heath hen habitat, hunting pressure was extreme, and by 1821 the formerly common bird was rare in New England. The last reports of heath hens in Pennsylvania and New Jersey are from 1869, and it is doubtful that the heath hen survived much after that on mainland North America.
zh:
①石南鸡的衰落始于第一批欧洲人到达北美东海岸之时。
②在欧洲人定居之前，美洲原住民利用火来维持森林、灌木林、农田和草地的混杂状态。
③在欧洲疾病导致美洲原住民人口锐减后，东北部以前开阔的栖息地大部分变成了森林，导致鸟类群落发生了重大变化，可能也减少了适宜的石鸡栖息地。
④虽然欧洲定居者对森林的清理可能再次增加了石南鸡的栖息地，但狩猎压力极大，到 1821 年，这种以前常见的鸟类在新英格兰已经很少见了。
⑤宾夕法尼亚州和新泽西州最后一次关于石南鸡的报道是在 1869 年，此后石南鸡在北美大陆的存活率很低。

qs.stem: Which of the following statements about the impact of European settlers on the heath hen is supported by the passage?
qs.zh: 关于欧洲定居者对石南鸡的影响，以下哪项陈述得到了文章的支持？

opts.t: The first Europeans indirectly precipitated a decrease in suitable heath hen habitats.
opts.cn: 第一批欧洲人间接导致了适宜的石南鸡栖息地的减少。

opts.t: European settlers hastened the decline of the heath hen through hunting.
opts.cn: 欧洲定居者通过狩猎加速了石南鸡的减少。

opts.t: The growth of European settlements may have increased suitable heath hen habitats.
opts.cn: 欧洲定居点的增长可能增加了适宜的石南鸡栖息地。

qs.label: A B C
qs.why:
文章第三句提到：“After European diseases decimated Native American populations, the formerly open habitats of the Northeast became largely forested, resulting in major changes to bird communities and probably reducing suitable heath hen habitat.”欧洲人的到来带来了欧洲疾病，这些疾病使得美洲原住民人口大幅减少。由于原住民数量的减少，他们无法继续使用火来维持开放的栖息地，导致东北部地区的开放栖息地变成了大片森林。这种变化减少了适合heath hen的栖息地。因此，欧洲人间接导致了适合heath hen栖息地的减少，A选项正确。

文章第四句提到：“...hunting pressure was extreme, and by 1821 the formerly common bird was rare in New England.”欧洲定居者对heath hen进行了过度的狩猎，狩猎压力非常大。结果是，到1821年，这种曾经常见的鸟类在新英格兰已经变得稀有。因此，欧洲定居者通过狩猎加速了heath hen的衰退，B选项正确。

文章第四句提到：“Although the clearing of forests by European settlers probably once again increased heath hen habitat...”欧洲定居者清理了森林，这可能再次增加了适合heath hen的栖息地，C选项正确。（尽管如此，由于过度的狩猎压力，这种鸟类仍然走向了灭绝。）

qs.stem: Which of the following can be inferred about the action mentioned in the highlighted portion of the passage?
qs.zh: 关于文中加粗部分提到的行动，可以推断出以下哪项？

opts.t: It was facilitated by the use of fire to maintain a mosaic of forests and open habitats.
opts.cn: 使用火来维持森林和开阔栖息地的混杂有利于这一行动。

opts.t: It partially reversed changes to bird communities that occurred in the previous century.
opts.cn: 它部分扭转了上个世纪鸟类群落发生的变化。

opts.t: It failed to compensate for the effects of overhunting the species.
opts.cn: 未能弥补过度捕猎对鸟类造成的影响。

opts.t: It resulted from a deliberate effort to conserve the species.
opts.cn: 这是刻意保护该物种的结果。

opts.t: It had a significant positive impact on a species that was already close to extinction.
opts.cn: 对一个已经濒临灭绝的物种产生了重大的积极影响。

qs.label: C
qs.why:
定位到加粗所在句："Although the clearing of forests by European settlers probably once again increased heath hen habitat, hunting pressure was extreme, and by 1821 the formerly common bird was rare in New England."“虽然欧洲移民清理森林可能再次增加了石南鸡的栖息地，但狩猎压力非常大，到1821年，这种曾经常见的鸟类在新英格兰已经很稀少了。”
这表明，尽管森林清理增加了石南鸡的栖息地，但由于过度狩猎，石南鸡的数量仍然大幅减少。因此，可以推断出森林清理的行动未能抵消过度狩猎对该物种造成的负面影响，对应C选项。

其他选项：
It was facilitated by the use of fire to maintain a mosaic of forests and open habitats.
错在时序与因果关系。用火来维持混合地貌是美洲原住民早期的行为，而欧洲人的清林是在原住民减少之后的行为。文中并没说“砍伐森林”是通过用火来完成的，也没有说是延续了原住民的做法。

It partially reversed changes to bird communities that occurred in the previous century.
文中并没提到“鸟类群落”在欧洲人清林后恢复。只说heath hen的栖息地可能增加了，但并没说明鸟类群落得以恢复。

It resulted from a deliberate effort to conserve the species.
文中没有任何证据表明欧洲人砍林是为了保护heath hen，这只是他们的土地使用行为，并不一定出于生态保护目的。

It had a significant positive impact on a species that was already close to extinction.
如果有“显著正面影响”，heath hen就不会在1821年变得稀有。文章反而强调了“狩猎压力极大”导致其稀有，说明正面影响有限，不构成“significant positive impact”。

html: Many herbivorous insects utilize plant resources during small windows of development or during short periods when plants are of suitable quality. Such temporal associations have been documented in numerous systems, where temporal constraints limit insect abundance and affect insect feeding strategy. Classic studies of winter moths, for example, suggest that the synchrony of larvae with leaf emergence is a primary determinant of larval success. Because many insect-plant associations have a temporal component, they may be negatively affected by environmental changes; some scientists fear, for example, that global warming may decouple insect-plant synchrony. Hellman, however, notes that the timing of insect-plant synchrony is affected by many factors, including insects' behavioral and physiological ability to adapt to changing host plant quality and the availability of alternative host resources.
zh:
①许多食草昆虫在植物发育的小窗口期或植物品质适宜的短时期内利用植物资源。
②在许多系统中都有这种时间关联的记录，在这些系统中，时间限制会限制昆虫的数量并影响昆虫的取食策略。
③例如，对冬蛾的经典研究表明，幼虫与叶片萌发的同步性是幼虫成功的主要决定因素。
④由于许多昆虫与植物的关系都具有时间性，它们可能会受到环境变化的负面影响；例如，一些科学家担心全球变暖可能会使昆虫与植物的同步性脱钩。
⑤不过，H 指出，昆虫与植物同步的时间受到许多因素的影响，包括昆虫适应寄主植物质量变化的行为和生理能力以及替代寄主资源的可用性。

qs.stem: The author discusses Hellmann in the last sentence of the passage primarily in order to
qs.zh: 作者在该段最后一句讨论 H 主要是为了

opts.t: suggest that the negative effects of environmental changes on insect-plant synchrony may be mitigated by certain variables
opts.cn: 表明环境变化对昆虫-植物同步性的负面影响可以通过某些变量来缓解

opts.t: provide support for scientists' concern that global warming may play a role in disturbing insect-plant synchrony
opts.h: provide support for scientists' concern that global warming may play a role in disturbing insect-plant synchrony
opts.cn: 为科学家对全球变暖可能会扰乱昆虫与植物同步性的担忧提供支持

opts.t: cast doubt on the hypothesis that there is a temporal component in many insect-plant associations
opts.cn: 对许多昆虫-植物关系中存在时间因素的假说表示怀疑

opts.t: highlight the importance of timing in the relationship between many insects and the plants upon which they rely for food
opts.cn: 强调时间在许多昆虫与它们赖以生存的植物之间关系中的重要性

opts.t: undermine the conclusions about insect-plant associations that have been drawn by scientists in classic studies of winter moths
opts.cn: 削弱科学家在对冬蛾的经典研究中得出的有关昆虫与植物关系的结论

qs.label: A
qs.why:
文章结构——
前半段：很多食草昆虫在植物适宜的短时间窗口利用植物资源（有时间性）。
例子：冬蛾的幼虫与叶子萌发同步是成功的关键。
科学家的担忧：气候变暖可能打乱昆虫与植物的同步（decouple insect–plant synchrony）。
最后一句（Hellmann观点）：这种同步的时间由很多因素决定，包括昆虫适应植物质量变化的行为/生理能力，以及其他可替代食物的存在。

Hellmann 提醒我们，虽然环境变化可能打乱同步，但同步的时间还受其他因素影响，这意味着影响不一定那么严重，可能被缓解。选A选项。

其他选项：
provide support for scientists' concern that global warming may play a role in disturbing insect-plant synchrony 前一句是“some scientists fear… global warming may decouple…” → 这是科学家的担忧；
但 Hellmann 的话并不是支持，而是指出还有其他因素影响，实际上是在削弱单一担忧的绝对性。

cast doubt on the hypothesis that there is a temporal component in many insect-plant associations
原文开头直接说 “many insect–plant associations have a temporal component” 并给例子（冬蛾）。Hellmann 没有否定这个事实，只是在说时间因素受多方面影响。

highlight the importance of timing in the relationship between many insects and the plants upon which they rely for food
文章前面（冬蛾例子）确实强调了 timing 重要性，但 Hellmann 的部分不是强调 timing，而是强调 timing 受多因素影响。

undermine the conclusions about insect-plant associations that have been drawn by scientists in classic studies of winter moths
Hellmann 没有否定冬蛾的研究结论，只是补充说 timing 会受其他因素影响。

qs.stem: The "classic studies of winter moths" provide direct support for which of the following propositions?
qs.zh: “对冬蛾的经典研究 "直接支持了以下哪项命题？

opts.t: Most herbivorous insects utilize plant resources only during limited time periods.
opts.cn: 大多数食草昆虫只在有限的时间内利用植物资源。

opts.t: Insect feeding strategies and survival are affected by seasonal growth patterns of plants.
opts.cn: 昆虫的取食策略和生存受到植物季节性生长模式的影响。

opts.t: Insect-plant synchrony may be preserved in many instances by insects' ability to adapt to changing environmental conditions.
opts.h: Insect-plant synchrony may be preserved in many instances by insects' ability to adapt to changing environmental conditions.
opts.cn: 在许多情况下，昆虫与植物的同步性可以通过昆虫适应不断变化的环境条件的能力来保持。

qs.label: B
qs.why:
定位到加粗所在句：Classic studies of winter moths, for example, suggest that the synchrony of larvae with leaf emergence is a primary determinant of larval success. 例如，经典研究关于冬蛾表明，幼虫与叶片出现的同步性是幼虫成功的主要决定因素。这句话直接说明了植物的季节性生长模式（即叶片的出现）对昆虫（冬蛾幼虫）的取食策略和生存有直接影响。“经典的冬蛾研究”直接支持的论点是，昆虫的取食策略和生存受到植物季节性生长模式的影响，对应B选项。

其他选项：
Most herbivorous insects utilize plant resources only during limited time periods.
这句话虽然在文章开头提到，“Many herbivorous insects utilize plant resources during small windows of development…”，但这是对多种昆虫的总体描述，并不是“classic studies of winter moths”所直接提供的证据。冬螟蛾研究只是举例说明时间同步的重要性，并没在该研究中对“多数植食性昆虫”作泛化论断。

Insect-plant synchrony may be preserved in many instances by insects' ability to adapt to changing environmental conditions.
有关昆虫适应性的信息是 Hellman 所指出的：“the timing of insect-plant synchrony is affected by many factors, including insects' behavioral and physiological ability to adapt…”，并不是来自“classic studies of winter moths”，所以也不是这个研究直接支持的内容。

html: Paintings of property—anything that was possessed—such as those created by eighteenth-century British painter George Stubbs were condemned by several of Stubbs's contemporaries: objects thus “individualized” would appeal to our appetite to own and enjoy them, whereas “generalized” objects in other paintings were no longer merely things but abstract ideas. To collect or commission paintings displaying lofty unconcern with materiality was considered by these commentators a mark of taste and civic virtue, the ability to subordinate private material interests to the abstract, public interest. Yet this notion of disinterested taste and virtue was founded on private interest: it was because the “public” man or woman already owned enough that he or she was presumed to be free from the urge to own more. Political power and status were thus based on the ownership of property, while at the same time they were legitimated by the claim that the avaricious behavior associated with the acquisition of property was somehow transcended by those who had already acquired it.
zh:
①财产（任何拥有的东西）的画像，比如18世纪英国画家GS创作的那些，受到了同时代人的谴责：这样“个性化”的物体会吸引我们拥有和享受它们的欲望，而其他绘画中的“广义”物体不再仅仅是事物，而是抽象的想法。
②这些评论者认为，收藏或委托他人创作表现出对物质性漠不关心的崇高画作是品味和公民美德的标志，即将私人物质利益置于抽象公共利益之下的能力。
③然而，这种无私的品味和美德的概念是建立在私人利益之上的：正是因为“公众”男人或女人已经拥有了足够的东西，所以他或她被认为没有拥有更多的欲望。
④因此，政治权力和地位是建立在财产所有权的基础上的，而与此同时，同时它们又通过声称已经拥有财产的人不再有贪婪行为来合法化自己。

qs.stem: Which of the following best describes the relationship of the first sentence to the passage as a whole?
qs.zh: 第一句与全文的关系如何描述最佳？

opts.t: It introduces a topic that is then placed in historical context.
opts.cn: 它介绍了一个随后置于历史背景中的主题。

opts.t: It introduces two contradictory approaches that are ultimately reconciled.
opts.cn: 它介绍了两种相互矛盾的方法，最终和解。

opts.t: It presents an argument that is then strengthened by evidence.
opts.cn: 它提出了一个论点，然后通过证据加强。

opts.t: It argues in favor of a position that is subsequently modified.
opts.cn: 它支持一个随后被修改的立场。

opts.t: It describes a viewpoint whose inconsistencies are later probed.
opts.cn: 它描述了一个观点，其不一致性后文被探究。

qs.label: E
qs.why:
第一句提到十八世纪一些评论家批评 George Stubbs 的画作中对具体物件的描绘（“individualized” objects），因为这种画作迎合了人们对占有和享乐的欲望，而他们更推崇描绘抽象概念的作品。接下来，文章进一步探讨了这些评论家观点中的矛盾之处：他们倡导一种“超脱物质”的审美观念，但这种观念实际上是建立在物质拥有的基础之上（“disinterested taste and virtue was founded on private interest”）。
所以，第一句引出了一个观点，后文详细探讨了这个观点，并揭示了其内部的不一致性。选E选项。

其他选项：
It introduces a topic that is then placed in historical context.
虽然提到了 Stubbs 的画作和评论家的观点，但没有深入到特定的历史背景中讨论（例如 Stubbs 的具体历史地位或时代背景），而是在集中探讨观点本身的内在矛盾。

It introduces two contradictory approaches that are ultimately reconciled.
文中提到的两种概念（“individualized” 物件与“generalized” 物件）确实存在矛盾，但后文没有调和这两者，而是重点探讨了“超脱物质”观点的内在矛盾。

It presents an argument that is then strengthened by evidence.
第一句不是一个论证，是陈述了一种批评观点。后文也没有通过证据强化这个论证，而是揭示了这个批评的矛盾之处。

It argues in favor of a position that is subsequently modified.
第一句没有为某种立场辩护，而是客观描述了一种评论家的观点。后文也没有对这一观点进行修改，而是分析批评内部的矛盾之处。

qs.stem: The primary purpose of the passage is to
qs.zh: 文章的主要目的是

opts.t: examine the origins of a particular style of painting
opts.cn: 审查某种特定绘画风格的起源

opts.t: analyze the paintings of a particular school
opts.cn: 分析某个特定学派的绘画作品

opts.t: point out the weakness that underlies a criticism
opts.cn: 指出批评背后存在的薄弱之处

opts.t: compare two different approaches to the painting of objects
opts.cn: 比较两种不同的物体绘画方法

opts.t: rebut a criticism of a particular painter’s integrity
opts.cn: 反驳对某个画家正直的批评

qs.label: C
qs.why:
文章提到：“Paintings of property... were condemned by several of Stubbs's contemporaries...”
→ 描述了GS 的画作被当时人批评：因为他把“财产”画得很具体，会引起人们的占有欲。

批评者认为，“generalized” objects... were abstract ideas
→ 比较抽象、理想化的画更符合“公共精神”。

然而，作者并不支持这种批评，反而指出了一个矛盾：“Yet this notion... was founded on private interest: it was because the ‘public’ man or woman already owned enough...”
→ 这些人所谓的“公共精神”，其实是因为他们已经够富有，所以可以假装“超然”。
作者通过这点，揭示了这些批评者逻辑上的问题，也就是他们批评别人贪婪，其实自己是因为“已经有了”，才不再显得贪婪。

文章的重点就是批评那些批评Stubbs的人，揭露他们的道德批评其实是建立在自己已拥有财产的基础上，是自相矛盾的。选项C选项。

其他选项：
examine the origins of a particular style of painting
文章不是在讨论绘画风格从哪来，而是在讨论社会意义和对绘画的评价。

analyze the paintings of a particular school
作者没有深入分析画作本身风格或主题，只是提到了一位画家和人们的反应，焦点在社会批评和逻辑矛盾。

compare two different approaches to the painting of objects
虽然有提到 individualized vs. generalized，但目的是为了揭示批评逻辑的问题，不是要“比较”两种风格。

rebut a criticism of a particular painter’s integrity
作者关注的是批评的逻辑问题，而不是在为Stubbs本人辩护或谈他的“人格”。

qs.stem: According to the passage, which of the following is true about the painting of property as it is described in the passage?
qs.zh: 根据这段文字，以下哪项对文中描述的财产绘画是正确的？

opts.t: It was typified in the work of George Stubbs.
opts.cn: GS的作品就是典型代表。

opts.t: It was usually commissioned by persons who had great political power.
opts.cn: 通常是由拥有巨大政治权力的人委托绘制的。

opts.t: It was regarded in the eighteenth century as a mark of good taste.
opts.cn: 在十八世纪，它被视为高品味的标志。

opts.t: It was at its most popular in eighteenth-century Britain.
opts.cn: 它在十八世纪的英国最为流行。

opts.t: It was advocated primarily by those who owned a great deal of property.
opts.cn: 它主要由那些拥有大量财产的人提倡。

qs.label: A
qs.why:
文章第一句就提到了GS是18世纪的英国画家，他创作的画作涉及“拥有的一切”（即财产），这种画作类型在文中被描述为以S的作品为典型，对应A选项。

其他选项：
It was usually commissioned by persons who had great political power.
文中没有提到这类画的委托者是谁，无法推断此选项。
It was regarded in the eighteenth century as a mark of good taste.
文中提到财产绘画是被批评的，不是品味的象征。
It was at its most popular in eighteenth-century Britain.
文中没有提到“流行程度”，无法判断。
It was advocated primarily by those who owned a great deal of property.
文中提到这类画被批评，没有提到提倡者是谁。

html: Writing about nineteenth-century women’s travel writing, Lila Harper notes that the four women she discussed used their own names, in contrast with the nineteenth-century female novelists who either published anonymously or used male pseudonyms. The novelists doubtless realized that they were breaking boundaries, whereas three of the four daring, solitary travelers espoused traditional values, eschewing radicalism and women’s movements. Whereas the female novelists criticized their society, the female travelers seemed content to leave society as it was while accomplishing their own liberation. In other words, they lived a contradiction . For the subjects of Harper’s study, solitude in both the private and public spheres prevailed—a solitude that conferred authority, hitherto a male prerogative, but that also precluded any collective action or female solidarity.
zh:
①LH在谈到19世纪女性的旅行写作时指出，她讨论的四位女性都使用了自己的名字，而19世纪的女性小说家要么匿名出版，要么使用男性假名。
②毫无疑问，小说家们意识到她们正在打破界限，而四位勇敢、孤独的旅行者中有三位信奉传统价值观，避开激进主义和妇女运动。
③当女性小说家批评她们的社会时，女性旅行家似乎满足于在实现自我解放的同时离开社会。
④换句话说，她们生活在矛盾之中。
⑤对于H的研究对象来说，私人和公共领域的孤独感占了上风——这种孤独感赋予了权力，迄今为止是男性的特权，但也排除了任何集体行动或女性团结。

qs.stem: Which of the following best characterizes the “contradiction” that the author refers to?
qs.zh: 以下哪一项最能说明作者所指的“矛盾”？

opts.t: The subjects of Harper’s study enjoyed solitude, and yet as travelers they were often among people.
opts.cn: H研究的对象喜欢独处，但作为旅行者，他们经常与人相处。

opts.t: Nineteenth-century travel writers used their own names, but nineteenth-century novelists used pseudonyms.
opts.cn: 19世纪的旅行作家使用自己的名字，但19世纪的小说家使用化名。

opts.t: Women’s movements in the nineteenth-century were not very radical in comparison with those of the twentieth-century.
opts.cn: 与20世纪相比，19世纪的妇女运动并不十分激进。

opts.t: Nineteenth-century female novelists thought they were breaking boundaries, but it was the nineteenth-century women who traveled alone who were really doing so.
opts.cn: 19世纪的女小说家认为她们在打破界限，但真正打破界限的是19世纪独自旅行的女性。

opts.t: While traveling alone in the nineteenth-century was considered a radical act for a woman, the nineteenth-century solitary female travelers generally held conventional views.
opts.cn: 虽然19世纪女性独自旅行被认为是激进行为，但19世纪的独自女性旅行者通常持有传统观点。

qs.label: E
qs.why:
E选项反映了文段中提到的“矛盾”：这些女性旅行家在进行被认为是激进的单独旅行的同时，她们通常持有传统的观点。这种矛盾体现在她们通过旅行实现个人解放，但并不支持女性运动或社会改革，即“the female travelers seemed content to leave society as it was while accomplishing their own liberation.”

其他选项：
The subjects of Harper’s study enjoyed solitude, and yet as travelers they were often among people.
文段提到的是女性旅行家们在个人和公共领域中的孤独，以及这种孤独如何带来了权威，但这与她们是否在人群中并没有直接联系。
Nineteenth-century travel writers used their own names, but nineteenth-century novelists used pseudonyms.
这个选项描述了一个事实对比，但并没有涉及到文段中提到的矛盾，即女性旅行家的传统观念与她们的独立行为之间的矛盾。
Women’s movements in the nineteenth-century were not very radical in comparison with those of the twentieth-century.
文中没有提过这个对比。
Nineteenth-century female novelists thought they were breaking boundaries, but it was the nineteenth-century women who traveled alone who were really doing so.
文中提到的是两者不同的表达方式，而不是哪一种更具突破性。

qs.stem: According to the passage, solitude had which of the following effects for the nineteenth century female travelers?
qs.zh: 根据文章，孤独感对19世纪女性旅行者产生了以下哪些影响？

opts.t: It conferred an authority typically enjoyed only by men.
opts.cn: 它赋予了通常只有男性才能享受的权威。

opts.t: It prevented formation of alliances with other women.
opts.cn: 它阻止了与其他女性建立联盟。

opts.t: It relieved peer pressure to conform to traditional values.
opts.cn: 它减轻了迎合传统价值观的同辈压力。

qs.label: A B
qs.why:
根据solitude定位到最后一句：For the subjects of Harper’s study, solitude in both the private and public spheres prevailed — a solitude that conferred authority, hitherto a male prerogative, but that also precluded any collective action or female solidarity.
A选项对应“a solitude that conferred authority, hitherto a male prerogative”，B选项对应“precluded any collective action or female solidarity”。
C选项里的“peer pressure”在原文没有对应的内容。

html: Historical demographers have generally agreed on two interrelated features of the urban populations in early-modern Germany. First in accordance with the law of natural decrease, extremely high mortality rates in cities (urban areas with more than 10,000 inhabitants) meant that their populations could not be sustained by reproduction alone. Population density, inadequate sanitary conditions, and poor housing made cities too vulnerable to disease and death. Second, when city populations did increase, it was as a result of in-migration suﬃcient to overcome the population losses caused by the high mortality. But because the parish registers of urban communities with fewer than 10.000 inhabitants show that the annual number of births usually equaled or exceeded that of deaths, historical demographers assume that the law of natural decrease did not apply to small towns.
zh:
① 历史人口统计学家普遍同意关于德国早期现代城市人口的两个相关特征。
②首先，根据自然减少法则，城市（人口超过1万的城市地区）的极高死亡率意味着其人口无法仅仅通过生育来维持。
③人口密度、不足的卫生条件和糟糕的住房让城市过于容易受到疾病和死亡的威胁。
④其次，当城市人口增加时，是由于足够多的人口流入弥补了高死亡率所造成的人口损失。
⑤但是，由于居民少于10000人的城市社区的教区登记显示，年出生人数通常等于或超过死亡人数，历史人口学家认为自然减少定律不适用于小城镇。

qs.stem: The author suggests that according to historical demographers, the birth rate in early-modern German cities
qs.zh: 作者认为，根据历史人口学家的说法，德国近代早期城市的出生率

opts.t: was aﬀected by sanitary conditions
opts.cn: 受到卫生条件的影响

opts.t: increased as a result of in-migration
opts.cn: 由于人口流入而增加

opts.t: was lower than the annual death rate
opts.cn: 低于年死亡率

opts.t: decreased as population density increased
opts.cn: 随着人口密度的增加而减少

opts.t: was lower than the rate in communities with fewer than 10,000 inhabitants
opts.cn: 低于居民少于10000人的社区的出生率

qs.label: C
qs.why:
原文明确指出，超过一万人的城市出生率无法与死亡率持平或超过，而低于一万人的小镇则通常能做到出生数等于或超过死亡数，说明城市的出生率相对更低，对应C选项。（“...extremely high mortality rates in cities (urban areas with more than 10,000 inhabitants) meant that their populations could not be sustained by reproduction alone. [...] parish registers of urban communities with fewer than 10,000 inhabitants show that the annual number of births usually equaled or exceeded that of deaths…”）

其他选项：
was affected by sanitary conditions
原文提到死亡率受卫生条件影响：“Population density, inadequate sanitary conditions, and poor housing made cities too vulnerable to disease and death.” 这段话讨论的是死亡率，而不是出生率。

increased as a result of in-migration
迁入人口只是弥补了死亡率高造成的人口流失，并不是提高出生率的原因。文中没有说迁入导致了出生率上升。

decreased as population density increased
原文没有提到出生率因人口密度变化而变化，只说人口密度影响死亡率。

was lower than the rate in communities with fewer than 10,000 inhabitants
原文提到的是小城镇的出生率通常等于或高于死亡率，但这并不直接意味着城市的出生率更低。城市人口总数减少是因为死亡率更高，而不是出生率更低于小城镇的出生率。

html: Kam-Biu Liu's examination of sediments from Western Lake, Florida, on the coast of the Gulf of Mexico, shows strikes by twelve very severe hurricanes in the past 3,400 years. Yet almost all occurred more than 1,000 years ago suggesting that hurricane activity was much higher then. What would account for this change? Liu believes long-term changes in the position and strength of the Bermuda high could be responsible. The Bermuda high, an annual area of high pressure in the North Atlantic, helps determine whether hurricanes forming in the Caribbean head west into the Gulf or veer north. Thus, there were not more hurricanes; it is just that more hit the Gulf Coast. Sediments from the Atlantic coast farther north, from Cape Cod to Virginia Beach, support this hypothesis.
zh:
①KBL对墨西哥湾沿岸佛罗里达州西湖沉积物的检查显示，在过去3400年中，有12次非常严重的飓风袭击。
②然而，几乎所有这些都发生在1000多年前，这表明当时的飓风活动要高得多。
③这一变化的原因是什么？
④L认为，百慕大高点的位置和力量的长期变化可能是原因。
⑤百慕大高压是北大西洋的一个年度高压区，有助于确定在加勒比海形成的飓风是向西进入海湾还是转向北方。
⑥因此，并非是有了更多的飓风；只是有了更多飓风到达了墨西哥湾沿岸。
⑦从科德角到弗吉尼亚海滩的大西洋海岸沉积物支持了这一假设。

qs.stem: It can be inferred that the “sediments” mentioned in the final sentence of the passage provide evidence that
qs.zh: 可以推断，最后一句提到的 “沉积物 ”提供了以下证据

opts.t: in the North Atlantic hurricanes have occurred no more frequently over the last 1,000 years than in the preceding 2,400
opts.cn: 在过去的 1000 年中，北大西洋飓风的发生频率并不比之前的 2400 年高

opts.t: during the last 3,400 years, the point at which North Atlantic hurricanes most commonly strike the North Atlantic coast has been moving steadily northward
opts.cn: 在过去的 3400 年中，北大西洋飓风最常袭击北大西洋海岸的地点一直在稳步北移

opts.t: the Bermuda high did not affect weather patterns in the North Atlantic and the Gulf of Mexico until about 1,000 years ago
opts.cn: 百慕大高地直到大约 1000 年前才对北大西洋和墨西哥湾的天气模式产生影响

opts.t: compared with what occurred at Western Lake, between Virginia Beach and Cape Cod hurricanes became more common in the last 1,000 years
opts.cn: 与西湖的情况相比，弗吉尼亚海滩和科德角之间的飓风在最近 1000 年变得更加常见

opts.t: the sediments from Western Lake do not record some severe hurricanes that struck the coast of the Gulf of Mexico in the period beginning 3,400 years ago
opts.cn: 西湖的沉积物没有记录从 3400 年前开始袭击墨西哥湾沿岸的一些严重飓风

qs.label: D
qs.why:
西湖（位于墨西哥湾沿岸）的记录显示，近 1,000 年内飓风活动明显减少；
同时，百慕大高压位置和强度的长期变化可能导致飓风的路径转向，从而更多地袭击大西洋较北部的海岸；
最后一句中提到的“Sediments from the Atlantic coast farther north, from Cape Cod to Virginia Beach, support this hypothesis”是用来支持这一观点，即飓风袭击点向北移动，导致北大西洋沿岸的飓风活动增加。即，可以推出在弗吉尼亚海滩到科德角之间的区域，在过去 1,000 年里飓风变得更加频繁，对应D选项。

其他选项：
in the North Atlantic hurricanes have occurred no more frequently over the last 1,000 years than in the preceding 2,400.
文章的重点在于飓风袭击点的改变，不是整体频率。

during the last 3,400 years, the point at which North Atlantic hurricanes most commonly strike the North Atlantic coast has been moving steadily northward.
“moving steadily”指一个连续、均匀的趋势，但文章只提供了两区域对比的证据，没有提过“steadily”。

the Bermuda high did not affect weather patterns in the North Atlantic and the Gulf of Mexico until about 1,000 years ago.
作者认为百慕大高压长期以来一直影响飓风的行进路径。

the sediments from Western Lake do not record some severe hurricanes that struck the coast of the Gulf of Mexico in the period beginning 3,400 years ago.
文章没讨论记录不全的问题。

qs.stem: Which of the following best describes the issue raised by the question in the highlighted portion of the passage?
qs.zh: 以下哪一项最能描述文章加粗部分提出的问题？

opts.t: What caused occurrences of a phenomenon to be unevenly distributed across time?
opts.cn: 是什么原因导致一种现象在时间上分布不均？

opts.t: What caused occurrences of a phenomenon to be more severe when they happened in an earlier period and less severe in a later one?
opts.cn: 是什么导致一种现象在早期发生时更严重，而在后期发生时不那么严重？

opts.t: Why is a physical record of a phenomenon less reliable for a more recent period than it is for an earlier one?
opts.cn: 为什么一个现象的物理记录在最近一段时间比在早期更不可靠？

opts.t: Why is a particular location more prone to a certain kind of occurrence than are other apparently similar locations?
opts.cn: 为什么一个特定的地点比其他明显相似的地点更容易发生某种事件？

opts.t: Can a particular methodology be relied on, given that it has produced an anomalous result?
opts.cn: 考虑到一种特定的方法产生了异常的结果，它能被依赖吗？

qs.label: A
qs.why: this change指的前两句说在过去3400年中，墨西哥湾沿岸有12次非常严重的飓风袭击，几乎所有都发生在1000多年前。加粗句子问的是要如何解释这一现象，即为什么飓风袭击都集中在1000多年前，对应A选项。

html: Elizabeth Bishop’s Complete Poems(1927-1979) has come to seem to most of its readers so achieved and sufficient as a life’s work that it is hard not to lose sight of how slowly Bishop wrote poems and of how few poems, finally, she completed. But Bishop herself never ceased to find her productivity inadequate. The size and pace of her output were always in her eyes a failing (vaguely moral in complexion ) for which she apologized throughout her career, although, as I will argue in this essay, Bishop’s inability to write more poems than she did was also a refusal to do so. The small, manageable size of Bishop’s body of work has facilitated its extraordinary critical reception since her death. (Robert Lowell, whose oeuvre is so much larger, has never had a complete edition of his poetry published.) Yet the size of her work is also a sign of Bishop’s alienation, that is, her uneasy, resistant relation to the literary culture that today claims her as the major poet of her generation.
zh:
①EB 的《诗歌全集》（1927–1979）在大多数读者眼中，作为她一生的心血之作，已经显得如此精湛而完整，以至于人们很容易忽视她写诗的进程有多么缓慢，以及她最终完成的诗篇是多么稀少。
②但B本人从未停止过对自己的低产不满。
③在她看来，诗作的数量和速度始终是她的一个缺陷（隐约带有道德色彩），为此她在整个创作生涯中一直在道歉，不过，正如我在本文中要论证的那样，B 无法写出比她所写的更多的诗也是一种拒绝。
④B 的作品篇幅小，易于驾驭，这为她去世后评论界对其作品的接受提供了便利。(RL 的作品数量要多得多，却从未出版过完整的诗集）。
⑤然而，B 作品的篇幅也表明了她的疏离感，即她与文学文化之间不安、抵触的关系，而今天的文学文化则称她为同时代的主要诗人。

qs.stem: In the context in which it appears, “complexion” most nearly means
qs.zh: 在上下文中，"complexion "最接近的意思是

opts.t: appearance
opts.cn: 外观

opts.t: constitution
opts.cn: 体质

opts.t: hue
opts.cn: 色调

opts.t: intricacy
opts.cn: 复杂性

opts.t: personality
opts.cn: 个性

qs.label: B
qs.why: 因为在原文中，“moral in complexion” 表示 EB 将自己的作品数量不足视为一种“道德上的缺陷”。在这个语境下，“complexion” 更接近于“体质”或“性质”（constitution），即一种道德上的特质或构成。

qs.stem: The passage indicates that the small size of Bishop’s body of work contributed to bringing about which of the following?
qs.zh: 这段文章表明，B作品数量较少导致以下哪个结果？

opts.t: Bishop’s alienation from the literary culture of her generation
opts.cn: B与她那一代文学界的疏离

opts.t: The favorable scholarly attention that Bishop’s work has received since her death
opts.cn: B作品自她去世以来所受到的学术关注

opts.t: An interest among readers regarding why Bishop wrote so slowly
opts.cn: 读者对B为何写作缓慢的兴趣

qs.label: B
qs.why:
最后一句说”the size of her work is also a sign of Bishop’s alienation“，B作品数量少是她与文学界疏离的体现，而不是数量少导致了疏离，不选A选项。
倒数第二句说” The small, manageable size of Bishop’s body of work has facilitated its extraordinary critical reception since her death.“，对应B选项。
第一句说的B的作品”so achieved and sufficient as a life’s work“ ，以至于读者对B写诗慢和作品少感兴趣，而不是数量上让读者对B为何写作缓慢的兴趣，不选C选项。

html: It is common to quote David Hume arguing against the possibility of reasoned ethics—for example, his observation that "the rules of morality . . . are not conclusions of our reason." Hume's remarks on the relation between reason and ethics are so myriad that it would be presumptuous to seek a definitive clarification of his position. But it is worth noting that immediately preceding the remark just quoted, Hume declares: "Morals excite passions, and produce or prevent actions. Reason of itself is utterly impotent in this particular." The qualification "of itself" is important to note. This is, in fact, not an argument that reason is unimportant for morality or for motivating action. It argues only that reason cannot accomplish this entirely on its own.
zh:
①人们经常引用DH的话来反对理性伦理学的可能性--例如，他认为 "道德规则......不是我们理性的结论"。
②H关于理性与伦理学之间关系的论述不胜枚举，因此要想明确阐明他的立场未免太冒昧了。
③但值得注意的是，在刚刚引述的这段话之前，H宣称 "道德激发激情，产生或阻止行动。理性本身在这方面完全无能为力"。
④需要注意的是 "本身 "这个限定词。
⑤事实上，这并不是在论证理性对于道德或激励行动并不重要。
⑥它只是论证了理性不能完全依靠自身的力量来实现这一点。

qs.stem: The primary purpose of the passage is to
qs.zh: 这段话的主要目的是

opts.t: argue that contrary to the conventional interpretation, Hume saw reason as playing the central role in ethical decisions
opts.cn: 证明与传统解释相反，H认为理性在伦理决策中起着核心作用

opts.t: suggest that Hume viewed reason and morality as being equally strong motivations for action
opts.cn: 说明H认为理性和道德是同样强大的行动动机

opts.t: criticize Hume for failing to provide a definitive clarification of his position on the relationship between reason and ethics
opts.cn: 批评H未能明确阐明他对理性与道德之间关系的立场

opts.t: explain why Hume's view of the relationship between reason and ethics has been widely misunderstood
opts.h: explain why Hume's view of the relationship between reason and ethics has been widely misunderstood
opts.cn: 解释为什么H关于理性与道德之间关系的观点被广泛误解

opts.t: contend that Hume's view of the relationship between reason and ethics is more complicated than is often suggested
opts.h: contend that Hume's view of the relationship between reason and ethics is more complicated than is often suggested
opts.cn: 认为H关于理性与道德之间关系的观点比人们通常认为的要复杂得多

qs.label: E
qs.why:
文章的主要目的是主张，相比通常的解读，H关于理性与伦理关系的观点比人们通常认为的要复杂，对应E选项。
文章提到，H关于理性与伦理的关系的评论极其丰富，以至于寻求他立场的明确阐释会显得自以为是。H在被引述的评论前明确声明：“道德激发情感，并产生或阻止行动。理性本身在这一点上完全无能为力。”文章强调了“本身”这一限定词的重要性，说明这实际上并不是在争论理性对于道德或激励行动不重要，而只是争论理性不能完全独立地完成这一任务。

其他选项：
argue that contrary to the conventional interpretation, Hume saw reason as playing the central role in ethical decisions
文章强调的是理性无法独自完成道德判断，而不是理性是中心。
suggest that Hume viewed reason and morality as being equally strong motivations for action
文章中 H 认为“理性本身”对于激发行动完全无能为力，这表明他并没有将理性和道德视为同等强的动机。
criticize Hume for failing to provide a definitive clarification of his position on the relationship between reason and ethics
原文并没有批评 H，而是说他的说法太多，不适合我们做出明确结论（“it would be presumptuous…”）。这里是理解难度的陈述，不是批评。
explain why Hume's view of the relationship between reason and ethics has been widely misunderstood
虽然前半段提到了一种“common”误解，但全文更侧重的是 H 观点的复杂性，而不仅仅是解释误解的原因。

qs.stem: It can be inferred from the passage that the author would most likely agree Hume thought that
qs.zh: 从这段话中可以推断出，作者很可能同意H下面哪个观点

opts.t: reason could influence action, but only in conjunction with some other factor
opts.cn: 理性可以影响行动，但必须与其他因素相结合

opts.t: reason could be used to justify ethical principles that were arrived at by some means other than reason
opts.cn: 理性可以用来证明通过理性之外的其他方式得出的伦理原则的合理性

opts.t: passions could be restrained by reason, but not in cases where the passions are especially strong
opts.cn: 激情可以被理性抑制，但在激情特别强烈的情况下则不行

opts.t: knowledge of moral rules is acquired prior to knowledge of proper reasoning
opts.cn: 道德规则的知识是在掌握正确的推理知识之前获得的

opts.t: the relationship between reason and ethics is fundamentally opaque
opts.cn: 理性与道德之间的关系从根本上说是不透明的

qs.label: A
qs.why:
定位到最后两句：This is, in fact, not an argument that reason is unimportant for morality or for motivating action. It argues only that reason cannot accomplish this entirely on its own. 这说明H认为理性在道德或激发行动方面确实有其作用，但这种作用需要与情感或其他因素相结合才能发挥。

其他选项：
reason could be used to justify ethical principles that were arrived at by some means other than reason
H 并没有指出理性可以用来为非理性方式得出的道德原则辩护。H 主要强调理性本身在道德行为中的作用有限。
passions could be restrained by reason, but not in cases where the passions are especially strong
H 的观点是理性自身无法充分制约情感，特别是在情感特别强烈的情况下。文中没有提及理性可以在某些情况下制约情感。
knowledge of moral rules is acquired prior to knowledge of proper reasoning
文中没有讨论道德规则的知识是在理性认知之前获得的。
the relationship between reason and ethics is fundamentally opaque
H 的观点并不认为理性和道德之间的关系完全不清楚，而是明确指出了理性在激发道德行为中的有限作用。

html: Having a larger assortment to choose from increases consumers’ expectations about matching their preferences. The heightened expectations seem logical, since assortments containing more or more varied items should increase the degree to which preferences can be matched. In practice, however, as assortment size increases, the degree to which consumers realize better preference matches often rises relatively little. Larger assortments may not actually offer more variety, the market may simply not supply an envisioned offering, or in the absence of sophisticated search tools, consumers may miss a better preference match even if it is available. Therefore, larger assortments can increase the likelihood that expectations will not be met, leaving consumers less satisfied with options chosen from larger rather than smaller assortments.
zh:
①拥有更大的产品组合可供选择，增加了消费者对匹配他们的偏好的期望。
②期望值的提高似乎是合乎逻辑的，因为包含更多或更多多样化的分类应该会增加偏好的匹配程度。
③然而，在实践中，随着分类规模的增加，消费者实现更高偏好匹配度的程度通常只有相对较小的上升。
④更大的产品组合实际上可能不会提供更多的多样性，市场可能根本无法提供预期的产品，或者在缺乏复杂的搜索工具的情况下，即使有更好的偏好匹配，消费者也可能错过。
⑤因此，较大的产品组合会增加无法达到预期的可能性，使消费者对从较大而非较小的产品组合中选择的选项不太满意。

qs.stem: In the highlighted portion of the passage, the author assumes that
qs.zh: 在文章的加粗部分，作者假设了

opts.t: consumers’ attitude toward the assortment of choices they are presented with depends almost exclusively on the size of the range
opts.cn: 消费者对各种选择的态度几乎完全取决于可选范围的大小

opts.t: consumers who have clear preferences make their choices more quickly than those whose preferences are relatively vague
opts.cn: 有明确偏好的消费者比偏好相对模糊的消费者更快地做出选择

opts.t: consumers’ anticipation of meeting specific expectations directly affects their satisfaction with a selected option
opts.cn: 消费者对满足特定期望的预期直接影响他们对所选选项的满意度

opts.t: consumers presented with an assortment of choices often adjust the preferences they had beforehand
opts.cn: 消费者面对各种各样的选择，往往会调整他们事先的偏好

opts.t: consumers presented with a larger assortment of choices often make their decisions too quickly
opts.cn: 面对选择种类繁多的消费者往往决策太快

qs.label: C
qs.why:
加粗句中写道：“larger assortments can increase the likelihood that expectations will not be met, leaving consumers less satisfied with options chosen from larger rather than smaller assortments.”
“更大的选品范围会增加期望无法得到满足的可能性，从而让消费者对从大规模而非小规模选品中所选选项的满意度降低。”
这一句的逻辑是：如果消费者对所选商品预期很高（anticipation of meeting specific expectations），而这些期望落空，就会直接导致他们对所选商品不满意（directly affects their satisfaction）。
所以，作者假设了“消费者对满足特定期望的预期会直接影响他们对所选选项的满意度”，对应C选项。

其他选项：
consumers’ attitude toward the assortment of choices they are presented with depends almost exclusively on the size of the range
文中并没把“态度”仅仅归因于规模大小，反而指出了多种因素会影响实际满意度：“Larger assortments may not actually offer more variety, the market may simply not supply an envisioned offering, or in the absence of sophisticated search tools, consumers may miss a better preference match even if it is available.”
作者并不认为消费者的态度“几乎完全”取决于选品规模。

consumers who have clear preferences make their choices more quickly than those whose preferences are relatively vague
原文没有讨论“决策速度”或“偏好明确度”与满意度的关系。

consumers presented with an assortment of choices often adjust the preferences they had beforehand
文中也没有暗示消费者在看见选品后会“调整原先偏好”，只是强调期望与实际匹配度的问题。

consumers presented with a larger assortment of choices often make their decisions too quickly
原文并没提“决策过快”会导致不满意。

html: Human impacts on the natural environment during the later part of the Holocene (beginning about 4,000 years ago) complicate investigations into environmental change during that period because the signals produced by human-and climate-induced change are sometimes difficult to separate. For example, in the later Holocene, one indicator of increased aridity due to climate change is an increase in pollen from grasses, as forest vegetation gives way to grassland. Such a change in vegetation could alternatively be attributed to human impact in the form of agricultural development. Examples of such human impact from 4,000 years ago would be small-scale, however, since the broad ecosystem changes brought about by the widespread adoption of agricultural technologies occurred later.
zh:
①全新世晚期（约 4000 年前开始）人类对自然环境的影响使得对这一时期环境变化的研究变得更加复杂，因为人类和气候引起的②变化所产生的信号有时很难分开。
③例如，在全新世晚期，气候变化导致干旱加剧的一个指标是，随着森林植被让位于草原，来自禾本科植物的花粉增多。
植被的这种变化也可以归因于以农业发展为形式的人类影响。
④不过，4000 年前的这种人类影响的例子规模较小，因为农业技术的广泛采用所带来的生态系统的广泛变化是后来才发生的。

qs.stem: According to the passage, which of the following is true regarding environmental changes 4,000 years ago?
qs.zh: 根据文中所述，以下哪项关于4000年前的环境变化是正确的？

opts.t: No localized increases in grass pollen were caused by agricultural development.
opts.cn: 农业发展并没有造成局部地区草花粉的增加。

opts.t: Increases in grass pollen were at least sometimes a reflection of an increase in aridity.
opts.cn: 草花粉的增加至少有时是干旱加剧的反映。

opts.t: Wholesale ecosystem changes probably resulted from agricultural development.
opts.cn: 生态系统的整体变化可能是农业发展造成的。

opts.t: Any small-scale changes occurring then would not be detectable now.
opts.cn: 当时发生的任何小规模变化现在都无法察觉。

opts.t: Environmental change helped induce the adoption of agricultural technologies.
opts.cn: 环境变化有助于农业技术的采用。

qs.label: B
qs.why:
第一句话明确提到草花粉的增加是由于“气候变化导致的干旱”引起的。说明草花粉的增加至少有时可以反映干旱程度的增加，对应B选项。

其他选项：
No localized increases in grass pollen were caused by agricultural development.
原文提到草花粉的增加“可能”是农业活动导致的，并没有否认这一可能性（“…could alternatively be attributed to human impact in the form of agricultural development”）。

Wholesale ecosystem changes probably resulted from agricultural development.
原文明确说明4,000年前的人类活动是“小规模的”（“Examples of such human impact from 4,000 years ago would be small-scale”），而“大范围生态系统变化”是在更晚时期发生的。

Any small-scale changes occurring then would not be detectable now.
原文并未提到这些小规模变化是否“无法检测”。

Environmental change helped induce the adoption of agricultural technologies.
原文没有提到环境变化导致农业技术被采用的因果关系。

html: The area of literary rights is confusing for scholars whose work focuses on collaborative materials particularly materials of earlier Native American writers. Questions arise over authorship and the determination of literary heirs. For example, recognition of heirs turns on the European-based assumption of the private ownership of a written statement. The first person to writer down an oral tale can become legally recognized as the owner of that version of the story, just as the first chemist to patent a tribal healing practice becomes the owner of the resulting chemical formula. This insistence on private rather than collective ownership, derived from the nineteenth-century notion of the autonomous, creative, authorial voice, flies in the face of those who come from an oral tradition. Thus a scholar concerned with finding literary heirs in order to afford them the benefits of copyright laws must in so doing accede to legal concept of ownership that has been used to appropriate knowledge from community- based cultures.
zh:
①对于那些专注于合作材料（尤其是早期美国原住民作家的材料）的学者来说，文学权利领域是令人困惑的。
②在作者身份和文学继承权的确定方面存在一些问题。
③例如，对继承人的承认取决于基于欧洲的书面声明私人所有权的假设。
④第一个写下口头故事的人可以被法律承认为该故事版本的所有者，就像第一个为部落治疗实践申请专利的化学家成为由此产生的化学配方的所有者一样。
⑤这种坚持个人而非集体所有权的想法源于19世纪的自主创造、创意创作的观念，与那些来自口头传统的人相抵触。
⑥因此，学者若想找到文学继承人，让他们享受版权法带来的好处，就必须接受所有权的法律概念，这一概念已被用于从基于社区的文化中获取知识。

qs.stem: The example of a chemical patent is used to illustrate a
qs.zh: 一个化学专利的例子被用来说明一个

opts.t: legal mechanism by which community knowledge can be turned into private property
opts.cn: 将社区知识转化为私有财产的法律机制

opts.t: technological development that goes beyond  the scope of  nineteenth-century science
opts.cn: 超越19世纪科学范畴的技术发展

opts.t: government action that creates a temporary form of intellectual property
opts.cn: 创造临时形式知识产权的政府行动

opts.t: kind of expression that exists only in written, rather than oral, form
opts.cn: 仅存在于书面形式，而非口头形式的表达方式

opts.t: way in which medical innovation can be rewarded
opts.cn: 奖励医疗创新的方式

qs.label: A
qs.why:
化学专利的例子出现在第四句：The first person to writer down an oral tale can become legally recognized as the owner of that version of the story, just as the first chemist to patent a tribal healing practice becomes the owner of the resulting chemical formula.
作者举了两个例子，认为它们是类似的（just as）。后一句说（第五句）“ This insistence on private rather than collective ownership”指的就是第四句的两个把community knowledge转为private property的例子，对应A选项。

qs.stem: According to the passage, the notion of a literary heir depends on a presupposition that can be traced to
qs.zh: 根据文章，文学继承人的概念取决于一个预设，这个预设可以追溯到

opts.t: a confusion over the purposes of collaboration
opts.cn: 合作目的的混淆

opts.t: a misunderstanding between people from different cultures
opts.cn: 不同文化之间的误解

opts.t: a nineteenth-century view of authors as creative individuals
opts.cn: 将作者视为创造性个体的19世纪观点

opts.t: oral traditions that hand down knowledge through generations
opts.cn: 代代相传的口头传统

opts.t: scholars who first recorded oral tales in written form
opts.cn: 最早以书面形式记录口头故事的学者

qs.label: C
qs.why:
C选项对应第五句：This insistence on private rather than collective ownership, derived from the nineteenth-century notion of the autonomous, creative, authorial voice, flies in the face of those who come from an oral tradition.

其他选项：
a confusion over the purposes of collaboration
原文没有提到合作目的存在混淆。虽然提到了一些材料是“合作性的”（collaborative），但这与文学继承人假设的来源无关。

a misunderstanding between people from different cultures
原文有提到欧洲文化和基于社区的文化之间的差异，但这并不是“文学继承人”假设的来源。这里的重点是19世纪关于作者个人所有权的观念，而不是文化误解。

oral traditions that hand down knowledge through generations
原文提到口述传统（oral tradition）与基于私人所有权的法律概念相冲突，但它并不是文学继承人概念的来源。

scholars who first recorded oral tales in written form
原文提到学者将口述故事记录下来可能会被法律视为拥有这些版本的所有权，但这只是学者的行为结果，而不是文学继承人假设的来源。

html: While buying and selling were the primary interests of people who gathered at flourishing medieval markets, these were not the only activities people engaged in there. Trips to the market were also social occasions, providing a good place to see and be seen, as indirectly attested by texts deriding those who adorned themselves more elegantly to visit a market than to visit a church. Markets also provided a good place to hear and be heard. As venues for royal proclamations, markets' chief advantage lay in their popularity with the peasantry. In theory, parish churches were equally suitable in this respect, but in practice, royal administrators found that markets better enabled them to integrate rural areas into institutional chains of communication.
zh:
①虽然买卖是人们聚集在繁荣的中世纪市场的主要兴趣，但这并不是人们在那里从事的唯一活动。
②逛市场也是一种社交活动，它为人们提供了一个观赏和被观赏的好去处，这一点在揶揄那些为了逛市场而把自己打扮得比逛教堂还优雅的人的文章中得到了间接证明。
③集市也是倾听和被倾听的好地方。
④作为发布皇家公告的场所，集市的主要优势在于它深受农民的欢迎。
⑤从理论上讲，教区教堂在这方面也同样适用，但在实践中，王室管理者发现，集市更能使他们将农村地区纳入制度化的沟通链中。

qs.stem: Which of the following conclusions regarding royal proclamations can reasonably be drawn from the passage?
qs.zh: 从这段文字中可以合理地得出以下哪些关于皇家公告的结论？

opts.t: If made in parish churches, royal proclamations would be unlikely to be heard by peasants.
opts.cn: 如果在教区教堂发布皇家公告，农民不太可能听到。

opts.t: Royal administrators regarded it as important that the peasantry should know the content of at least some royal proclamations.
opts.cn: 王室管理者认为农民至少应该知道一些王室公告的内容，这一点很重要。

opts.t: Markets were the most effective venue for communicating royal proclamations to rural populations.
opts.cn: 市场是向农村居民传达皇家公告的最有效场所。

qs.label: B
qs.why:
最后一句提到“In theory, parish churches were equally suitable in this respect, but in practice, royal administrators found that markets better enabled them to integrate rural areas into institutional chains of communication.”理论上，教区教堂在传达皇家公告方面同样适合，但实际上市场更能使皇家行政人员将农村地区整合到通信的制度链条中。这并不表示在教堂里公告会不被农民听到，只是相较于市场，市场更受农民欢迎。因此，A选项不能从文中推出。

最后一句提到，皇家行政人员发现市场更能帮助他们将农村地区整合到通信的制度链条中。这暗示了皇家行政人员认为让农民知道至少一些皇家公告的内容是重要的。因此，B选项这个结论是合理的。

文章提到市场是皇家公告的场所之一，并指出其在农村人口中的受欢迎程度。这表明市场是一个有效的传达皇家公告给农村人口的场所。但是文章虽然指出了市场的受欢迎程度和相较于教区教堂的优势，但没有明确指出市场是“最”有效的场所，C不选。

qs.stem: In the context in which it appears, “attested” most nearly means
qs.zh: 在其出现的语境中，“attested ”最接近的意思是

opts.t: borne out
opts.cn: 证明...为真

opts.t: made sure of
opts.cn: 确定

opts.t: proclaimed
opts.cn: 宣布

opts.t: decided
opts.cn: 决定

opts.t: vindicated
opts.cn: 证明...的正当性/无罪

qs.label: A
qs.why:
在上下文中，“attested”一词的意思最接近于“证明为真实”或“证实”。
文中提到一些文章揶揄某些人装扮得比去教堂还要讲究，从而间接表明了市场是一个展示自己的地方。选borne out (证明为真实)

html: In 1961, Julia Child published Mastering the Art of French Cooking, frequently described as revolutionary. According to legend, Child inspired Americans to exchange their bland cooking for French cuisine's rich flavors. Yet Child's book was hardly singular among cookbooks. One publishing catalog lists almost as many books about French cooking in the decade before Child's book as in the decade after. While Child's book influenced a particular American cohort, its effect on the American publishing industry was minimal, a fact at odds with popular assumptions both about publishers and about Child's importance. We might expect Child's success to foster many imitators. Instead American cookbooks pursued themes popular before Child's book was published, including a growing interest in the American cooking styles allegedly vanquished by Child.
zh:
①1961年，JC出版了《掌握法国烹饪的艺术》，这本书经常被描述为革命性的。
②据这个传奇说，C激励美国人放弃他们平淡无奇的烹饪方式，转而采用法国菜肴的丰富风味。
③然而，C的书在烹饪书籍中并非独一无二。
④一个出版目录显示，在C的书出版的前十年里，关于法国烹饪的书籍几乎与其后十年的数量相同。
⑤尽管C的书对特定的美国人群产生了影响，但其对美国出版行业的影响微乎其微，这一事实与人们对出版商以及C重要性的普遍假设不符。
⑥我们可能会期望C的成功会催生许多模仿者。
⑦相反，美国的烹饪书籍继续追求C的书出版之前就受欢迎的主题，包括对被C所据称击败的美国烹饪风格的日益浓厚兴趣。

qs.stem: Which of the following, if true, could be most plausibly cited as evidence in support of the “legend”?
qs.zh: 以下哪一项，如果属实，最有可能被引用为支持“传奇”的证据？

opts.t: The segment of the American public that purchased cookbooks grew significantly after 1961.
opts.cn: 1961年后，购买烹饪书的美国公众比例大幅增长。

opts.t: Child's Mastering the Art of French Cooking outsold all other books on French cooking in 1961.
opts.h: Child's Mastering the Art of French Cooking outsold all other books on French cooking in 1961.
opts.cn: 1961年，JC的《掌握法国烹饪的艺术》的销量超过了所有其他关于法国烹饪的书籍。

opts.t: American cooking became less marked by regional differences than it had been prior to 1961.
opts.cn: 与1961年之前相比，美国烹饪的地区差异变得不那么明显了。

opts.t: Many American dishes typically prepared by home cooks prior to 1961 declined in popularity.
opts.cn: 许多在1961年以前通常由家庭厨师烹制的美国菜肴的受欢迎程度有所下降。

opts.t: Culinary experts in France came to regard American cooking differently than they had prior to 1961.
opts.cn: 法国的烹饪专家开始对美国烹饪的看法与1961年之前有所不同。

qs.label: D
qs.why:
首先定位到加粗部分所在句，看"legend"的具体内容：According to legend, Child inspired Americans to exchange their bland cooking for French cuisine's rich flavors. 这个传奇是，JC的书激发了美国人放弃他们单调的烹饪方式，转而采用法国菜肴的丰富风味。如果在1961年之前普遍流行的美国菜肴在受欢迎程度上有所下降，这可能意味着美国人的烹饪习惯的确发生了变化，D选项能支持"legend"。

其他选项：
The segment of the American public that purchased cookbooks grew significantly after 1961.
更多的人开始购买烹饪书，不能直接证明这些人转向了法式烹饪。

Child's Mastering the Art of French Cooking outsold all other books on French cooking in 1961.
虽然这显示了Child的书在当年非常畅销，但并没有直接证明它对美国烹饪习惯的长期影响。

American cooking became less marked by regional differences than it had been prior to 1961.
这一点可能显示了美国烹饪趋于统一，但不一定是因为法国料理的影响。

Culinary experts in France came to regard American cooking differently than they had prior to 1961.
法国烹饪专家对美国烹饪的看法变化并不能证明美国本土烹饪习惯的改变。

qs.stem: It can be inferred from the passage that the “growing interest”
qs.zh: 从文中可以推断出“日益增长的兴趣”

opts.t: has been mischaracterized by some observers of American culinary trends of the 1960s
opts.cn: 被一些20世纪60年代美国烹饪趋势的观察家误解了

opts.t: would not have occurred if Child’s book had been the watershed some believed it was
opts.cn: 如果C的书是一些人认为的分水岭，就不会发生

opts.t: reflected Americans’ aspirations to be perceived as sophisticated about food and cooking
opts.cn: 反映了美国人渴望在食物和烹饪方面被认为是老练的

opts.t: bolstered certain trends in the publishing industry that accelerated the release of new cookbooks
opts.cn: 推动了出版业的某些趋势，加速了新烹饪书的发行

opts.t: confirms Child’s influence on at least one segment of the American public
opts.cn: 证实了C对至少一部分美国公众的影响

qs.label: B
qs.why:
定位到加粗部分所在句：Instead American cookbooks pursued themes popular before Child's book was published, including a growing interest in the American cooking styles allegedly vanquished by Child. 尽管有C的书（据称击败了美国烹饪风格），但对美国烹饪风格的兴趣依然存在和增长。
如果C的书真如某些人所认为的那样，彻底改变美国烹饪文化或出版行业的趋势，那么就不会出现“对美国烹饪风格的兴趣依然存在和增长”了，对应B选项。

其他选项：
has been mischaracterized by some observers of American culinary trends of the 1960s
文章并没有明确讨论1960年代的趋势被误解的具体方面，而是在讨论C的书对烹饪文化影响的普遍认识与实际情况之间的差异。

reflected Americans’ aspirations to be perceived as sophisticated about food and cooking
美国人希望被看作在食物和烹饪方面具有成熟品味。文章中没有提到关于美国人的这种愿望或动机，而是关注了C的书对美国烹饪文化和出版行业的实际影响。

bolstered certain trends in the publishing industry that accelerated the release of new cookbooks
作者明确指出“Child's book… its effect on the American publishing industry was minimal”。既然影响很小，就谈不上“加速”出版趋势。

confirms child’s influence on at least one segment of the American public
虽然文章提到C的书影响了特定的美国人群，但主要讨论的是对烹饪文化和出版行业的总体影响，而不是确认它对某一部分公众的影响。

qs.stem: The author mentions the “cohort” primarily to
qs.zh: 作者提到“群体”主要是为了

opts.t: refute the supposed homogeneity of American preferences in food
opts.cn: 驳斥美国人对食物偏好的同质化

opts.t: place a particular debate within its relevant historical context
opts.cn: 将一场特定的辩论置于其相关的历史背景下

opts.t: acknowledge some truth in a view that is otherwise inaccurate
opts.cn: 承认在其他方面不准确的观点中有一些真实性

opts.t: emphasize the inadequacy of a common assumption about french cuisine
opts.cn: 强调关于法国美食的一个普遍假设的不足

opts.t: challenge a particular view of what made Child’s book popular
opts.cn: 挑战一种特定的观点，即是什么使C的书广受欢迎

qs.label: C
qs.why:
定位到加粗部分所在句：While Child's book influenced a particular American cohort, its effect on the American publishing industry was minimal, a fact at odds with popular assumptions both about publishers and about Child's importance.” 虽然C的书对特定的美国群体有影响，但它对美国出版业的影响却很小，这与人们对出版商和C重要性的普遍假设不符。作者承认C的书在某种程度上确实有影响，但这种影响并不像普遍认为的那样广泛或深远。对应C选项。

其他选项：
refute the supposed homogeneity of American preferences in food
但这里的重点不是讨论“美国人之间的口味是否同质”，而是在限定 Child 的影响范围：她影响了“particular cohort”，但没有改变整个出版业。

place a particular debate within its relevant historical context
“cohort” 这里不是为了交代历史背景，而是在承认 Child 的影响确实存在，但只限于部分人。

emphasize the inadequacy of a common assumption about French cuisine
文中被质疑的不是“大家对法国菜的看法”，而是“Child 对美国饮食和出版业影响巨大”这个流行说法。
“cohort” 也没有在评价 French cuisine 本身。

challenge a particular view of what made Child’s book popular
文章没有讨论 Child 的书“为什么会流行”，也没有分析它受欢迎的原因。
作者讨论的是它的实际影响有多大，尤其是否改变了美国出版业，而不是 popularity 的成因。

html: Unlike herbivores and omnivores, predators have traditionally been thought not to balance nutrient intake because of the assumption that animal tissue as a food source varies little and is nutritionally balanced. But chemical analysis of invertebrate prey reveals remarkable variation in nutrient composition among species; even within species, nutrient composition may vary considerably. Greenstone suggested that predators may select food items according to their nutrient contents. Jensen et al (2011) have shown experimentally that even sit-and- wait invertebrate predators with limited mobility can work to address nutrient deficiencies. The wolf spider, for instance, has been shown to regulate nutrient intake by extracting more dry mass from a prey item if it contains a higher proportion of a nutrient that was deficient in the previous prey.
zh:
①与食草动物和杂食动物不同，食肉动物传统上被认为不会平衡营养摄入，因为人们假定动物组织作为食物来源变化很小，而且营养均衡。
②但是，对无脊椎动物猎物的化学分析显示，不同物种之间的营养成分差异显著；即使在同一物种内部，营养成分也可能有很大差异。
③G 认为，捕食者可能会根据食物的营养成分来选择食物。
④J 等人（2011 年）通过实验证明，即使是行动能力有限的无脊椎动物捕食者，也可以通过坐等来解决营养缺乏问题。
⑤例如，狼蛛就被证明可以调节营养摄入量，如果猎物所含的营养成分比例较高，狼蛛就会从该猎物中汲取更多的干物质，而这种营养成分正是前一个猎物所缺乏的。

qs.stem: Which of the following best describes the organization of the passage as a whole?
qs.zh: 以下哪个最好地描述了整个段落的组织方式？

opts.t: A phenomenon is described, and an interpretation is offered.
opts.cn: 描述了一种现象，并提供了解释。

opts.t: A claim is made, and the corroborating evidence is evaluated.
opts.cn: 提出了一个主张，并评估了支持的证据。

opts.t: A hypothesis  is presented  and undermined by recent  findings.
opts.cn: 提出了一个假设，并在最近的研究中被否定了。

opts.t: A contrast is noted and shown to be specious based on recent findings.
opts.cn: 指出了一个对比，并基于近期的发现证明其站不住脚。

opts.t: A series of assumptions is presented and shown to be based on sound reasoning.
opts.cn: 提出了一系列假设，并显示其基于合理推理。

qs.label: C
qs.why:
文章的思路：
1. 提出传统假设：文章一开始提出了一个传统的假设，即捕食者不会平衡营养摄入，因为认为动物组织作为食物来源变化不大，且营养均衡。
2. 引入新发现，削弱假设：接下来，文章通过新的研究发现，无脊椎猎物的营养成分在物种之间甚至同一物种内都有显著变化，从而削弱了上述假设。
3. 提供实验证据：最后，作者引用了Greenstone和Jensen等人的研究，证明捕食者实际上会根据营养需求选择猎物，调整营养摄入。

即，文章的结构是提出一个假设，然后通过新的研究发现来削弱或推翻这个假设，对应C选项。

其他选项：
A phenomenon is described, and an interpretation is offered.
文章不仅仅是描述和解释，而是挑战了一个传统假设。
A claim is made, and the corroborating evidence is evaluated.
文章并非在评估支持某个主张的证据，而是提供新证据来反驳传统假设。
A contrast is noted and shown to be specious based on recent findings.
虽然文章中提到了捕食者与食草动物和杂食动物的对比，但文章的重点不是强调对比的无效性。
A series of assumptions is presented and shown to be based on sound reasoning.
文章是质疑和推翻了传统假设，而不是证明其合理。

html: For Temnothorax ants in search of suitable rock crevices for new nest sites, size is an important consideration, and certain behaviors suggest how scouts might compare the size of several sites. After entering a crevice, scouts invariably exit and reenter. During their first inspection, they mark their route with their personal pheromones. (Experiments have shown that workers can distinguish their own pheromones from those of nest mates.) Some researchers believe that these ants are counting the frequency of intersections between their two exploratory trails: the smaller the area, the more likely they are to cross a spot twice. The observation that Temnothorax scouts always pave out a path of the same length on their first visit to sites strongly supports this hypothesis.
zh:
①对于寻找合适的岩石缝隙作为新巢址的 T蚂蚁来说，大小是一个重要的考虑因素，某些行为表明了侦察员可能会如何比较几个巢址的大小。
②进入岩缝后，侦察蚁总是要出来再进去。
③在第一次检查时，它们会用自己的信息素标记路线。
④(实验表明，工蚁可以分辨出自己的信息素和巢友的信息素）。
⑤一些研究人员认为，这些蚂蚁在计算它们两条探索路线之间的交叉频率：区域越小，它们越有可能在一个地方交叉两次。
⑥根据观察，T侦察蚁在第一次到访地点时，总是铺出一条相同长度的路径，这有力地支持了这一假设。

qs.stem: In light of the claim made by the “researchers”, it can be inferred that ants’ ability to distinguish their own pheromones from these of nest mates is important primarily because
qs.zh: 根据 "研究人员 "的说法，可以推断出蚂蚁区分自身信息素和巢中配偶信息素的能力之所以重要，主要是因为

opts.t: ants would otherwise be unable to tell whether potential mating sites were occupied by related colonies.
opts.cn: 否则，蚂蚁就无法分辨潜在的交配地点是否被相关的蚁群占据。

opts.t: the ability aids in the assignment of specific tracks such as scouting for new nests, among the various members of a nest.
opts.cn: 这种能力有助于在蚁巢的不同成员之间分配特定的任务，例如寻找新的蚁巢。

opts.t: ants who could not distinguish their own personal pheromones would be unable to tell if they had previously embraced a site
opts.cn: 如果蚂蚁不能分辨自己的信息素，它们就无法判断自己是否曾经接触过某个地点。

opts.t: pheromone differentiation is essential to account evaluation of potential nesting sites
opts.cn: 信息素的差异化对潜在筑巢地点的评估至关重要。

opts.t: pheromone differentiation is essential to ants’ ability to evaluate the size of crevices before entering them
opts.cn: 信息素分化对蚂蚁在进入缝隙前评估缝隙大小的能力至关重要。

qs.label: C
qs.why:
原文提到，蚂蚁在探索新巢穴时，会标记它们的路线并能区分自己和巢友的信息素。这种能力允许它们通过重复检测相同路径来评估地点大小。如果蚂蚁不能区分自己的信息素，它们就无法确定自己是否已经探索过某个地点，这对于它们通过信息素交叉来评估巢穴大小的能力至关重要，对应C选项。

其他选项：
ants would otherwise be unable to tell whether potential mating sites were occupied by related colonies.
文段讨论的是蚂蚁如何比较岩缝的“大小”（size）以选择筑巢地点，完全没有提到配偶（mating）或“相关殖民地”（related colonies）的问题，原文中也没有任何与此相关的描述。

the ability aids in the assignment of specific tracks such as scouting for new nests, among the various members of a nest.
虽然文中确实说到蚂蚁“在第一次勘察时用个人信息素标记路线”，但这个标记的目的是让个体蚂蚁自己分辨“哪条路是自己刚才走过的”，以便进行“交叉点计数”，而不是在群体内部分配谁来走哪条路。

pheromone differentiation is essential to account evaluation of potential nesting sites.
虽然信息素区分对整个“评估过程”确实有帮助，但它没有点明“为什么要分辨自己和同伴的标记”——核心在于要识别“自己”走过的路线，从而进行交叉计数。

pheromone differentiation is essential to ants’ ability to evaluate the size of crevices before entering them.
文中说的评估方法是——进入岩缝后“出—入”两次勘察并计数交叉点来判断空间大小，而不是“进入前”就做评价；且题干重点在于“分辨谁的信息素”以识别路线交叉，这个选项误导为“进入前”的评估。
